chapters.title: Chapter 2251: Is it finally happening?
paragraphs: "We need to tell him."
The first wife declared.
For a moment, no one spoke.
The words sounded simple, but they carried weight. They weren’t just talking about news anymore. They were talking about a future.
A... fragile future.
A future that could be hurt with a single mistake.
Felberta’s gaze moved around the room, meeting each pair of eyes one by one. She didn’t rush. She didn’t force a smile either.
"We cannot hide it. Not from him."
Then, she looked at Amaya and—
"And not from ourselves."
She spoke.
Amaya’s jaw tightened, but she didn’t look away.
Felberta continued.
"A child isn’t a secret. A child is... a responsibility."
Her voice turned firmer.
"A living piece of Nux.
A living piece of... us.
If something happens, if we make even a single mistake, we will regret it for the rest of our existence."
Skyla swallowed; those words felt... much heavier than she expected. Lane’s fingers curled into the edge of her sleeve.
Aeliana’s stare stayed sharp, but she nodded as well. She too understood that it was important.
Lyriana didn’t nod at first. She looked like she wanted to refuse, but then her eyes flickered, and she exhaled through her nose.
"...Fine,"
She muttered.
Felberta’s shoulders loosened a little.
"No matter what happens,
We will protect the child."
She spoke.
"That is obvious."
Vyriana snorted.
Again, none of the women liked this feeling, but some things couldn’t change, no matter what.
"We protect the family."
Ember nodded too.
Felberta nodded at the women, then her eyes moved to Shadow next.
"And you,"
She said, voice clear.
"No more peeking. Not unless we truly need it. We won’t be making a habit out of it."
"Hah? You talk as if I was the one who wanted it."
The Universe’s Goddess snorted, not taking any blame whatsoever. That was when Amaya glared at her.
Again, they had not forgotten the Sharnoth incident.
"Okay okay, stop glaring at me, will you?
I already learned my lesson anyway."
She muttered, then a teasing, superior smile appeared on her face and—
"Nux already made me realize that I was abad girlin his own way~
I have indeed learned my lesson~"
The woman spoke as she licked her lips; her silky sheets that covered her body began falling ever so slowly, almost deliberately.
The rest of the women felt their mouths twitching at those actions.
This was... definitely not a good time to tease them, and Shadow realized it very quickly, so she straightened up and wiped that smirk off her face.
"Yes. Learned. Fully."
She coughed as she sat straighter, covering her body completely.
The room didn’t laugh. But the tension eased quite a bit; it felt... familiar to see Shadow act like she normally does.
And then—
Felberta sighed.
"Call him,"
She spoke.
The words made the room go quiet again. No one disagreed, but they all knew that the moment they called him, everything would become... real.
"I’ll do it,"
Evane took a step forward.
Felberta nodded lightly.
The Elf closed her eyes. Just like all the women, her bond with Nux was always there, and the moment she reached out for him—
Space folded.
A ripple spread through the chamber, almost as if reality itself was being rewritten and—
Nux appeared near the bed, as if he had always been there.

He wore his usual teasing smile. His eyes were relaxed, almost amused. When he sensed almost all the women together in Shadow’s room, he expected to see Shadow throwing pillows at someone, or Skyla bouncing around with some new nonsense.
"Did you miss me that—"
But the next moment, his words stopped.
Because the room didn’t match his smile.
The air was heavy.
The women weren’t laughing.
Even Shadow wasn’t acting shameless.
As for the chamber they were in... half of it... no longer existed.
Nux’s smile faded in an instant.

Like the women, Nux too could sense their emotions no matter where he was. In fact, as the Universe himself, his authority over the bond was even higher than Shadow’s. He could see even their deepest thoughts without any trouble at all.
But Nux rarely did that.
It felt... wrong to him.

Like he was spying on them, not to mention there have been times when the surprise the women had prepared for him was ruined just because he sensed their excited emotions, so the women too strictly told him not to sense their emotions and promised to tell him the moment they felt sad or lonely, even if it was for no reason at all.
Anyway, what was important was, Nux had absolutely no clue what had happened, especially since he was with Sharnoth right now.
But the moment he came here—
He no longer needed their bond to sense their mood; he could see it on their faces.
"What happened?
Are you all alright?"
He asked, his voice filled with concern. He sensed if their bodies had any injuries, and other than Riona, whose hand stung a little, the others were fine.
Nux narrowed his eyes.
No one answered his question right away. Felberta stared at him for a long second.
Then—
"Allura is pregnant."
She dropped the bomb.
For a moment, Nux didn’t move.
"...what?"
"It’s true."
Shadow nodded quickly, as if she wanted to prove she wasn’t lying.
"I saw it."
Nux’s lips parted slightly.
His gaze moved, almost unconsciously, as he looked through the walls and glanced at Allura, instantly sensing their bond and... a new existence that linked them.
And the moment he sensed it—
His face changed again.
Shock didn’t vanish; it transformed into something far, far brighter.
Something warm.
Something... almost childlike.
Joy hit him so suddenly it made his breath catch.
"A child..."
He whispered, like the words themselves were unreal.
His eyes shined as he laughed; his heart could no longer hold the excitement.
He looked like he wanted to smile again, like he wanted to grab someone, spin them, do something stupid.
But then—
He froze.
His mind didn’t need to connect the dots to realize what had happened; he knew these women too well, he knew exactly what they were thinking, he knew exactly what they were... feeling.
The conflict.
The jealousy.
The... hurt.
The... bitterness that they were trying to hide.
And in an instant—
His joy faltered.
He looked at the entire room again, he saw the women’s faces, their body language, how they tried to hold back the flood of emotions they were feeling.
And then—
He saw Felberta.
Because Felberta was the first.
And she was holding the heaviest thing right now with the calmest face.
Nux went quiet.
His eyes lowered slightly.
He began.
But no words came out.
What could he even say?

He had no idea; he couldn’t think of any words that would comfort them, and for a man who claimed to know his women well and wouldn’t stop talking about how he would make sure none of them were ever sad in their entire life...
It was... like the sharpest sword was cutting his heart into small pieces, slowly, as painfully as possible.
His throat felt a lump, confused as to what it should do.
And Felberta saw it.
Of course she did; as the first, it came to her naturally.
So she smiled.
A beautiful, real smile.
"We are fine,"
She spoke with an earnest look on her face, one that would have fooled everyone.
But—
"You do not have to lie to me,"
But not Nux. He called her out immediately, his voice gentle but firm.
"I know you wanted to be the first,
I know that you are... unhappy."
He did not know any other way to describe it; Felberta’s emotions were far too strong to fit under a single word.
But then—
"Oh, I am."
Felberta nodded as if it was the most obvious thing in the world.
"I am not just sad.
I am extremely sad.
My mood is the worst it has ever been."

The women reacted to those words; Skyla blinked, she did not think Felberta would say it out loud. She expected Felberta to... lie. To say she was fine, bottle up her emotions so that Nux could truly feel happy and excited about his first child.
That was just the kind of woman Felberta was.
"Fel—"
Nux stared at Felberta, pain flickering in his eyes, but before he could say anything, Felberta raised a hand, stopping him.
"And this is why you are going to make it up to me,"
She declared in a smooth, soft voice.
And Nux—
He froze again, not knowing how to react.
And Felberta did not give him time to react either.
She leaned forward slightly, her gaze turning... hungry in a way the room recognized instantly.
"And you will give me what I want."
She demanded as she pulled Nux closer to her by his collar, looking right into his eyes with... desire in her own.
And Nux—
He could only gulp.
This was... a little too sudden.
His mind, however, understood what was about to happen and usually, he would be the one enjoying this the most.
But—
The situation wasn’t exactly the same as it usually was.
This time, the situation was... different.
Because this time, it wasn’t just Felberta who was looking at him with those hungry, urgent, and desirous eyes.
The rest of the women were no different.
Because the moment Felberta said those words out loud... it unlocked the same thought in every other woman’s head.
If she can demand it...
Why can’t we?
And now—
Every single one of them was staring at Nux with the same urgent, needy, desirous eyes.
And just then—
"Is it finally happening?
Am I getting the orgy I have always wanted!?
Are you all coming to the dark side???
We have cookies!!!"
Edda exclaimed in excitement.
"No cookies for Allura though,
That bitch doesn’t deserve it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2252: Oh ho? Look who came running.
paragraphs: "Allura Leander."
As Allura was strolling in a new world, enjoying its beauty with a smile on her face while she hummed a joyful tune, she heard a voice in her head.
It was Shadow.
But...
It wasn’t Shadow’s usual casual, banter-like voice, it was... different.
It was far more serious.
And that changed Allura’s expression.
Did something happen in the Main Universe?
Was Nux fine?
Such questions appeared in her head. In an instant, she tried to connect to Nux and her worry only became stronger when she couldn’t.
But before she could say or do anything, Shadow’s voice sounded again.
"You will stay here."
The Universe’s First Goddess declared in a solemn tone.
"You will be safe.
You will have everything you need.
But you will not leave."
"What...?"
Allura didn’t understand.
What was happening?
Why was she being locked away?
Was everything fine?
Where was Nux?
Why can’t she sense him properly?

More and more questions appeared in her mind and of course, Shadow knew what she was thinking. She didn’t need to read her mind for that, she knew the woman well enough to know how she would react to this.
And Shadow answered, this time, her tone much lighter than before.
"What ’What...’?
You betrayed us, you didn’t think there wouldn’t be consequences, did you?"
"What? Betrayed—?"
Allura frowned for a moment, but then, it clicked.
And the moment it did, she stopped.
After all, she knew she was wrong, she was... greedy and selfish.
"And now, you will be facing those consequences."
Shadow spoke and from her tone, Allura could tell how much the woman was trying to stop herself from smiling but failing nonetheless.
For a moment, that... relieved her.
After all, even if she ’betrayed’ them, it didn’t mean she didn’t care about them. She was just... too absorbed in the moment.
But she truly did not wish to hurt any of her sisters, so when she heard Shadow’s usual, teasing tone again, her mind eased a little and she... she gave in.
"For how long?"
She asked, accepting her ’punishment.’
And that was when Shadow’s smile widened even further.
"Indefinite."
She answered in a gleeful tone, making sure Allura knew that she was enjoying this.
And Allura...
She couldn’t say anything.
She could... only accept her fate.
That happened three months ago.
To mortals, three months was still a considerable amount of time, but to Transcendents who could live for Eternity?
It was nothing.
Or at least, that is how it should be.
But for Allura, those three months felt like a slow, cruel stretch of time that never ended because she lived through every moment alone.
Sure, the world Shadow had caged her in was beautiful.

It had soft skies, gentle light, warm wind, and quiet nights. It had endless trees with silver leaves. Rivers that ran clear and sweet. A mountain in the distance that never erupted, never shook, never threatened.
It was the perfect prison.
Allura stood near the river for the hundredth time, staring at the water as it flowed where she saw her own reflection.
And lately... her reflection made her chest tighten.
Because she looked the same.
Her body was strong.
Her aura was stable.
But there was something new now.
Something tiny.
Something delicate.
Something... alive.

She placed a hand on her stomach without thinking, not because her belly showed yet. At the level she was, her body didn’t change that quickly unless they allowed it. This was also one of the reasons why no one noticed it till then; she mostly did it out of habit and to... feel what was in there.
A child.
Nux’s child.
Her child.
Her fingers pressed lightly, and she whispered slightly.
"Where are you..."
She was missing him, the father of her child.
There was no answer.
Her bond with the others still existed; she could still ’feel’ their presence, that they were all fine.
But Shadow’s cage had dulled the rest.
Some women wanted to completely cut the connection so she wouldn’t be able to sense anything at all, but Shadow didn’t dare do that.
Not when Allura was in the condition she was in.
But even then, the current scenario was no different than torture either. In some twisted sense, it was even crueller than a complete cut-off.
The Succubus could still sense them, but she could not reach them.
She could not call.
She could not hear the casual chatter that used to fill her mind like background music.
She could not hear Skyla’s constant excitement.
She could not hear Felberta’s steady presence.
She could not hear Amaya’s sharp comments, or Shadow’s annoying teasing, or Evane’s simple questions.
Aisha’s and Edda’s absence felt like a voice too, more than the others did.
And the worst...
Nux.
Not being able to talk to him whenever she desired left a hole in her heart she couldn’t fill no matter how much she tried.
She had long become used to having her head constantly filled with different voices, so much that the silence now... made her run in circles.
At first, she tried to cultivate.
She truly did.
After all, they all wanted to get stronger for Nux’s sake.
She sat under the silver-leaved trees and closed her eyes, breathing slowly, letting her energy settle.
But every time she tried to ease her mind and focus, the same thoughts rose.
Where are they?
Are they angry?
Where is Nux?
Does he know?
Is he... angry?
Or is he... excited?
And then, the worst thought of all would creep in.
Are they... doingthat?
Allura’s cheeks would heat up every time that thought appeared, obviously not from shyness, but from the image that formed in her head every time she imagined that.
And how could it not?

She was one of Edda’s ’close friends’; the number of times she had heard that unholy woman talk about all those wild thoughts and fantasies that she had and the things she would do if her fantasy ever came true was... innumerable.
She had heard it so many times that at this point, Allura too seemed... open to it.

Of course, she still hadn’t fully accepted that idea, but just thinking about how the rest might be lying on the same bed while she is trapped in this darned place left her with an emptiness she had never dealt with before.
Her mind that continuously imagined everything did not make it any easier either.
Those hungry, greedy looks. Felberta demanding her right, the others following, and Nux caught in the middle.
Allura could imagine it all.
And the more she imagined it, the more... lonely she felt.
She wanted to be included as well.
And maybe she would have if she hadn’t betrayed them.
Allura’s mood worsened.
She tried to leave this world again, she had done it many times.
But against Shadow’s authority, she was... helpless.
Nothing she did worked against the power of the Universe’s Goddess.
She had even tried to call Nux directly through the bond once, and all she got was a faint pulse.
A pulse that told her he was alive.
And nothing else.
That pulse had saved her from losing her mind.
But it also made her hate Shadow even more.
Because she knew Shadow could have allowed more.
That woman simply didn’t want to.
Shadow wanted Allura to sit here and rot in her own thoughts.
So that was what happened.
Allura sat.
Allura waited.
Allura thought.
And time passed.
Finally,
On the ninety-third day, the sky changed.
Allura was sitting near the river when she felt it. Her eyes widened as she felt a familiar sensation in her head.
A presence.
Multiple presences.
So sudden, so... sharp, that her heart almost stopped.
And in an instant, she stood up and moved.
Yes, the Succubus could sense it; the restriction on her was gone, her imprisonment was... over.
The distance wasn’t much; with Allura’s speed, she crossed it within minutes and about fifteen minutes later—
She was there.
In front of a mansion she did not recognize, maybe it was something they made for their time together.
The Succubus felt a wave of jealousy when she thought about it, but that feeling disappeared in an instant because her eyes fell on them—
The familiar faces that walked out of the mansion.
Faces that had... ridiculously satisfied looks on their faces, faces so smug that for a moment, she wanted to slap them.
The women on the other side, however, didn’t seem to notice her. Their minds were... too foggy to notice anything.
"Heh, it’s good that we built this mansion."
Skyla nodded, satisfied.
"I told you~"
Edda nodded.
The look on her face showed... pure bliss.
A look Allura had never once seen on her face; it was clear that something big had happened. That was when she heard something else.
"I still can’t believe we won."
Rune commented, still in some disbelief.
"If he had won even today, I wouldn’t have shown my face for the next decade!"

Vyriana snorted, but of course, behind that snort, there was a proud smugness. She too was satisfied, especially as she glanced back at the door and thought about how a completely passed-out Nux lay there, helpless and... completely wrung dry.
"Indeed."
Astaria agreed with the Dragon’s words.
"Watching him groan as he passed out was satisfying to watch."
The Swordswoman nodded.
"Did you look at the face he had after falling unconscious?"
Thyra grinned.
"I’d never forget it."
Riona grinned.
The rest of the women smiled too.
And Shadow puffed her chest—
"Hmph, it took all of you to make him pass out, I did it alon—"
However, just as she was about to continue her boasting, her eyes turned and then, her grin widened even further.
"Oh ho?
Look who came running."

Allura frowned for a moment, but then, it clicked.
And the moment it did, she stopped.
After all, she knew she was wrong, she was... greedy and selfish.
"And now, you will be facing those consequences."
Shadow spoke and from her tone, Allura could tell how much the woman was trying to stop herself from smiling but failing nonetheless.
For a moment, that... relieved her.
After all, even if she ’betrayed’ them, it didn’t mean she didn’t care about them.
She was just... too absorbed in the moment.
But she truly did not wish to hurt any of her sisters, so when she heard Shadow’s usual, teasing tone again, her mind eased a little and she... she gave in.
"For how long?"
She asked, accepting her ’punishment.’
And that was when Shadow’s smile widened even further.
"Indefinite."
She answered in a gleeful tone, making sure Allura knew that she was enjoying this.
And Allura...
She couldn’t say anything.
She could... only accept her fate.
That happened three months ago.
To mortals, three months was still a considerable amount of time, but to Transcendents who could live for Eternity?
It was nothing.
Or at least, that is how it should be.
But for Allura, those three months felt like a slow, cruel stretch of time that never ended because she lived through every moment alone.
Sure, the world Shadow had caged her in was beautiful.
It had soft skies, gentle light, warm wind, and quiet nights.
It had endless trees with silver leaves.
Rivers that ran clear and sweet.
A mountain in the distance that never erupted, never shook, never threatened.
It was the perfect prison.
Allura stood near the river for the hundredth time, staring at the water as it flowed where she saw her own reflection.
And lately... her reflection made her chest tighten.
Because she looked the same.
Her body was strong.
Her aura was stable.
But there was something new now.
Something tiny.
Something delicate.
Something... alive.
She placed a hand on her stomach without thinking, not because her belly showed yet.
At the level she was, her body didn’t change that quickly unless they allowed it.
This was also one of the reasons why no one noticed it till then; she mostly did it out of habit and to... feel what was in there.
A child.
Nux’s child.
Her child.
Her fingers pressed lightly, and she whispered slightly.
"Where are you..."
She was missing him, the father of her child.
There was no answer.
Her bond with the others still existed; she could still ’feel’ their presence, that they were all fine.
But Shadow’s cage had dulled the rest.
Some women wanted to completely cut the connection so she wouldn’t be able to sense anything at all, but Shadow didn’t dare do that.
Not when Allura was in the condition she was in.
But even then, the current scenario was no different than torture either.
In some twisted sense, it was even crueller than a complete cut-off.
The Succubus could still sense them, but she could not reach them.
She could not call.
She could not hear the casual chatter that used to fill her mind like background music.
She could not hear Skyla’s constant excitement.
She could not hear Felberta’s steady presence.
She could not hear Amaya’s sharp comments, or Shadow’s annoying teasing, or Evane’s simple questions.
Aisha’s and Edda’s absence felt like a voice too, more than the others did.
And the worst...
Nux.
Not being able to talk to him whenever she desired left a hole in her heart she couldn’t fill no matter how much she tried.
She had long become used to having her head constantly filled with different voices, so much that the silence now... made her run in circles.
At first, she tried to cultivate.
She truly did.
After all, they all wanted to get stronger for Nux’s sake.
She sat under the silver-leaved trees and closed her eyes, breathing slowly, letting her energy settle.
But every time she tried to ease her mind and focus, the same thoughts rose.
Where are they?
Are they angry?
Where is Nux?
Does he know?
Is he... angry?
Or is he... excited?
And then, the worst thought of all would creep in.
Are they... doingthat?
Allura’s cheeks would heat up every time that thought appeared, obviously not from shyness, but from the image that formed in her head every time she imagined that.
And how could it not?

She was one of Edda’s ’close friends’; the number of times she had heard that unholy woman talk about all those wild thoughts and fantasies that she had and the things she would do if her fantasy ever came true was... innumerable.
She had heard it so many times that at this point, Allura too seemed... open to it.

Of course, she still hadn’t fully accepted that idea, but just thinking about how the rest might be lying on the same bed while she is trapped in this darned place left her with an emptiness she had never dealt with before.
Her mind that continuously imagined everything did not make it any easier either.
Those hungry, greedy looks.
Felberta demanding her right, the others following, and Nux caught in the middle.
Allura could imagine it all.
And the more she imagined it, the more... lonely she felt.
She wanted to be included as well.
And maybe she would have if she hadn’t betrayed them.
Allura’s mood worsened.
She tried to leave this world again, she had done it many times.
But against Shadow’s authority, she was... helpless.
Nothing she did worked against the power of the Universe’s Goddess.
She had even tried to call Nux directly through the bond once, and all she got was a faint pulse.
A pulse that told her he was alive.
And nothing else.
That pulse had saved her from losing her mind.
But it also made her hate Shadow even more.
Because she knew Shadow could have allowed more.
That woman simply didn’t want to.
Shadow wanted Allura to sit here and rot in her own thoughts.
So that was what happened.
Allura sat.
Allura waited.
Allura thought.
And time passed.
Finally,
On the ninety-third day, the sky changed.
Allura was sitting near the river when she felt it.
Her eyes widened as she felt a familiar sensation in her head.
A presence.
Multiple presences.
So sudden, so... sharp, that her heart almost stopped.
And in an instant, she stood up and moved.
Yes, the Succubus could sense it; the restriction on her was gone, her imprisonment was... over.
The distance wasn’t much; with Allura’s speed, she crossed it within minutes and about fifteen minutes later—
She was there.
In front of a mansion she did not recognize, maybe it was something they made for their time together.
The Succubus felt a wave of jealousy when she thought about it, but that feeling disappeared in an instant because her eyes fell on them—
The familiar faces that walked out of the mansion.
Faces that had... ridiculously satisfied looks on their faces, faces so smug that for a moment, she wanted to slap them.
The women on the other side, however, didn’t seem to notice her.
Their minds were... too foggy to notice anything.
"Heh, it’s good that we built this mansion."
Skyla nodded, satisfied.
"I told you~"
Edda nodded.
The look on her face showed... pure bliss.
A look Allura had never once seen on her face; it was clear that something big had happened.
That was when she heard something else.
"I still can’t believe we won."
Rune commented, still in some disbelief.
"If he had won even today, I wouldn’t have shown my face for the next decade!"
Vyriana snorted, but of course, behind that snort, there was a proud smugness.
She too was satisfied, especially as she glanced back at the door and thought about how a completely passed-out Nux lay there, helpless and... completely wrung dry.
"Indeed."
Astaria agreed with the Dragon’s words.
"Watching him groan as he passed out was satisfying to watch."
The Swordswoman nodded.
"Did you look at the face he had after falling unconscious?"
Thyra grinned.
"I’d never forget it."
Riona grinned.
The rest of the women smiled too.
And Shadow puffed her chest—
"Hmph, it took all of you to make him pass out, I did it alon—"
However, just as she was about to continue her boasting, her eyes turned and then, her grin widened even further.
"Oh ho?
Look who came running."

chapters.title: Chapter 2253: Who are you?
paragraphs: "Hmph, it took all of you to make him pass out, I did it alon—"
Shadow wanted to flaunt, but just as she was about to continue, her eyes fell on Allura and her grin widened even further.
"Oh ho?
Look who came running."
In an instant, the rest of the women turned in the direction Shadow was looking at and their eyes fell onher.
And the first to react was Aisha.
"Huh...? Who is she...?"
She tilted her head, confused.
"How did she get in here...? I thought this place wasn’t open tooutsiders.Shadow, did you forget to hide it?"
She asked, turning towards her new friend.
Shadow too caught on in an instant—
"Hmm? I was sure I hid it. Outsiders shouldn’t be able to find it."
She muttered, her head tilted in the same confusion.
"Then..."
Aisha muttered.
Then, she looked at Allura with a frown and—
"Who are you?"
She asked.
And Allura...
"Stop messing around, will you?"
She felt her mouth twitching.
"Hah? Woman, have you lost your mind?"
But Aisha wasn’t giving in. Instead, she turned towards the rest of the women and—
"Does any one of you know her?"
That was when Edda spoke up.
"Hmmmm. She does look familiar..."
She muttered as she leaned forward.
"She does...?"
Aisha frowned, then Edda shook her head.
"Ah, maybe it’s because she is a succubus. Her features seemed familiar."
"Ah."
Aisha nodded.
"That is true, she does look like a succubus, a somewhat strange succubus, but a succubus nonetheless."
Eisheth nodded as well.
"Hey! Are you lost!?"
Shadow raised her voice and asked the question from a distance.
And Allura...
She had no idea how to react to it.
So instead, she asked a question.
"What were you doing in there?"
"I don’t think you should be asking us private questions."
Skyla chuckled.
"Indeed."
Aisha nodded as well.
"What happened in there is ussistersbusiness, not someoutsider’s."
Purposefully focusing on certain words to alienate Allura even further.
And Allura exhaled.
"I know I made a mistake, I promise I will make it up to you.
Will you stop it?"
"Woman, I have no clue what you are talking about.
What mistake?"
But that was when Amaya spoke up.
"Make it up to us? How do you plan on doing that?"
The devourer asked, glaring at Allura with her piercing dark eyes.
And Allura...
Seeing the hatred and anger in Amaya’s eyes, she felt... relief.
At the very least, she found her attitude better than what Aisha and the others were doing.
"I... I do not know..."
Allura answered with a stutter, once again rubbing her belly out of habit.
"I know I was selfish, I couldn’t control myself.
I thought about how it would hurt you but I..."
Allura looked at Felberta and—
"I wanted to be the first this time..."
She spoke, lowering her head with guilt.

The rest of the women stared at her. The looks of disapproval on their faces hadn’t faded away. Sure, their minds were still on cloud nine, most of them were still having glimpses of the time they had spent inside.
They were... intoxicated.
But every time they thought about what Allura had done, their intoxication... vanished and was replaced by... anger.
Yes, the anger wasn’t as strong as it initially was, but it was still there.
And seeing Allura standing right in front of them, the anger only got stronger.
"So you wanted to be first so desperately that you decided to betray the woman you call your closest friend."
Aisha snorted. She still hadn’t forgiven her.
Allura lowered her head even further, the guilt only getting stronger.
"Alright, that is enough."
Suddenly, Felberta spoke up.
"There is no point discussing it any further."
Then, a gentle, ridiculously beautiful smile appeared on her face as she rubbed her belly as well.
"Not when we have to be... more responsible from now."
The women smiled at those words and Amaya—
She widened her eyes in disbelief.
"W-Wait... you..."
She stared at the women, then, she sensed their bonds and saw something she didn’t see before—
The women...
They were all pregnant!
Of course, since it was recent, the life inside still hadn’t developed, but it was happening. The women...
They were all carrying another life!
Another... Nux!
"What? Did you think only you can do it?"
Ember snorted, placing her hand over her belly as if it was the most precious thing in the world.
"At least none of us had to lie to get what we wanted."
Thyra snarked.
"Indeed, we didn’t have to betray any of our sisters."
Rune nodded as well.
"All of you would have done the same if you had the opportunity to!"
Allura snapped.
"Heh. You talk as if we didn’t have the opportunity."
Lyriana snorted, but Allura did not back down.
"You didn’t."
She stared at all the women present in front of her and—
"Look into my eyes and tell me none of you wanted to be the first, even if it means breaking our promise!"
The Succubus then specifically looked into Amaya’s eyes and—
"Tell me you would think about our promise instead of carrying Nux’s first child!"
And Amaya... she obviously couldn’t say that.
After all, that would be a lie.
And Allura knew that.

"You all blame me, but you know the truth as well. The only reason you did not act was because the time was not ideal. I myself had multiple worries and was willing to put myself under severe restrictions if it came down to it, even if it meant not being able to stand with Nux on the battlefield and hiding inside the Universe instead.
That was the only reason I went with it while you were still waiting.
So yes, while I agree I betrayed you, I did something unforgivable, every single one of you would have done the same if you were in my place!"
For a moment, nobody refuted her.
After all, they knew she wasn’t wrong.
The women stared at Allura in silence, their expressions tight. Some looked annoyed. Some looked hurt. Some looked like they were still fighting the urge to slap her.
And then, Aeliana clicked her tongue.
"You really have the audacity to say that out loud."
"Do you want me to lie?"
Allura snorted back.
"No, you already did that once."
Lyriana answered coldly.
Allura’s jaw tightened at those words, but she didn’t look away.
She no longer wanted to.
"I know."
"Hmph. You’re still annoying."
Skyla crossed her arms and puffed her cheeks.
"She’s always annoying. That’s what makes her... her."
Edda snickered.
"I’ll take that as love."
Allura’s mouth twitched.
Aisha didn’t laugh.
Her gaze stayed sharp as she walked forward, stopping right in front of Allura.
"I understand what you did."
She spoke.
Allura’s eyes softened for a second—but before she could say anything—
"And I’m still angry,"
Aisha finished, blunt.
Allura’s softness vanished.
Aisha continued like she was laying down rules in a contract.
"You will be careful from now on.
No reckless battles. No stupid risks. No sneaking around. If you feel even slightly unwell, you tell us."
"Why are you treating me like them?"
Allura clicked her tongue as she glanced at Astaria and Vyriana. The two women glared back at her, but before they could say anything—
"If you feel even slightly unwell, youwilltell us."
Aisha repeated her sentence, this time, in a much firmer tone.
"Okay."
Allura nodded slowly, and just as she was about to sigh in relief—
"And as punishment,
you’re losing your turns."
Aisha declared, without asking or waiting for her opinion.
"...My turns?"
Allura froze.
"Yes."
Aisha nodded, satisfied seeing the reaction she had imagined she would see.
Allura’s face blanked out.
Then she snapped,
"Aisha!"
"What?"
Aisha shrugged innocently.
"You wanted to be first so badly.
Now you can be first at resting."
Edda burst out laughing.
"Hehe~ That’s perfect!"
Skyla smirked as she pointed at Allura. The rest grinned as well.
"You’re all terrible,"
Allura muttered.
"Hmph."
Melia snorted.
Allura glared at the Vampire and repeated the same thing.
"Don’t act like you didn’t want the same thing."
Melia narrowed her eyes.
Then she looked away with a sharp "Tch."
Allura then glanced at the rest of the women and, seeing the unwilling acceptance on their faces, she smiled a little.
Felberta, who had been quiet until now, stepped forward as well.
"Allura,"
The first wife called softly.
Allura swallowed, feeling a little guilty.
Felberta then smiled—
"Let’s forget this happened."
Allura’s expression changed and Felberta continued—
"One of us had to be first anyway. There is no point beating ourselves up about it. It is not like it is going to change the way Nux looks at us."
Allura nodded at those words.
"What matters right now is we take care of ourselves, especially you."
The Succubus nodded again.
"So from now on, you will be under our special care."
"Special care...?"
Allura frowned.
"I’ll watch her all day! I’ll follow her everywhere!"
Skyla raised her hand excitedly.
"No."
Allura shook her head, instantly denying the idea.
"We’ll rotate shifts. So she won’t feel smothered."
Evane coughed lightly, her face calm, but her ears were faintly red.
Allura nodded at those words, but then she squinted her eyes as she glanced at the elf.
That was when she asked another question.
"Evane... what happened inside the mansion?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2254: What did you do?
paragraphs: "Evane."
Suddenly, Allura called out. The Elf looked at her sister and the Succubus narrowed her eyes.
"What happened inside the mansion?"
She asked and in an instant—
Evane froze, her blush deepening.

Allura narrowed her eyes even further. She tried to peek into Evane’s mind. She could tell the answer was in Evane’s surface thoughts, so it wouldn’t be difficult to get it, but the instant she tried—
She was blocked off.
"If you thought that would work, you are mistaken."
Shadow answered, the tip of her finger shining with a translucent light. The First Goddess of the Universe had used her Authority to block off Allura.
The Succubus turned silent.
She then glanced at Evane again and—
"Evane, you didn’t answer my question."
She spoke.
The Elf avoided the Succubus’s eyes and just as Allura was about to ask more—
Edda leaned close to Allura and—
"Don’t ask."
She whispered.
"Oh, I’m asking."
Allura’s curiosity ignited like a flame.
"I am telling you, you shouldn’t."
Aisha smirked. It was clear that unlike her words, shewantedAllura to ask, and that is what she did.
Since Evane did not answer, Allura turned to Felberta and—
"What did you do in there?"
And this time, even Felberta’s lips curved and a small but... dangerous smile appeared on her face.
"We... talked,"
The first wife answered.
Allura blinked.
"That is a lie."
She spoke directly.
"It is."
Felberta nodded like she was proud.
Allura’s mouth twitched.
She looked at the other women and—
"Tell me."
She raised her voice.
And the women...
They all grinned at each other.
Like conspirators.
Like... criminals who shared a secret.
"Whatever happened inside the mansion—"
Rune said with a satisfied sigh.
"—stays inside the mansion."
"And inside our hearts,"
Thyra added dramatically, placing a hand on her chest.
"And inside our bodies."
Edda added her own words.
The rest of the women stared at the perverted maid with deadpan looks on their faces and Allura—
If she had any doubts before...
Now, she was certain.
They did it.
Without her.
Her mouth twitched uncontrollably.
Edda laughed.
Allura stepped forward, narrowing her eyes.
"Where is Nux?"
The instant she said his name, the women’s smiles widened again.
And that didn’t make Allura feel any better.
It made her feel... suspicious.
"I want to see him,"
Allura said, trying to sound firm.
"Hmm... no."
Skyla tilted her head.
"What do you mean, no?"
Allura stared at her.
Aisha patted Allura’s shoulder.
"I don’t think you can see him for a good while."
She spoke with a... superior smirk.
Allura’s mouth twitched.
"...and why is that?"
She asked and Felberta’s smile turned even more polite.
"Because, he’s resting."
She answered slowly.
"Resting from what?"
Allura narrowed her eyes, even though she already knew the answer.
The women looked at each other again. Evane’s face turned completely red. Literal red.
"EVANE. Why are you blushing like that?"
Allura raised her voice. She did not like this feeling at all.
And the Elf in question—
She looked like she wanted to evaporate.
Skyla hugged Evane from the side and giggled.
"She... learned a few things~"
"What did you see?"
Allura demanded to know.
"Nothing."
Evane covered her face.
"That’s another lie."
"I swear—"
Edda leaned in again and whispered,
"Just stop asking,
You wouldn’t be able to handle it."
"I absolutely can."
Allura’s eyes flashed in protest.
"No, you can’t."
Aisha spoke confidently.
Allura glared at all of them, one by one.
Those smug, cruel... happy looks on their faces...
It annoyed her.
Especially the fact that they were all in this together, everyone except her.

But in the end, the Succubus too knew that there was nothing she could do about it. After all, she was the one who betrayed them all. The very fact they were at least talking to her and joking around with her was more than enough for now.
The Succubus then exhaled as she rubbed her belly again, trying to calm herself. Then she looked at Felberta and—
"Just... let me see him."
She asked softly, practically pleading.
Felberta’s expression softened slightly, but even then, there was nothing she could do. She just—
"You’ll see him.
Just not right now."
She repeated the same thing. After all, Allura truly couldn’t meet Nux right now.
He had... actually passed out.
Yes, the women had actually won this time.
Allura’s shoulders dropped.
She looked frustrated.
Lonely.
And... oddly needy.
The women noticed.
And even if they still hadn’t fully accepted what she did—
They didn’t push her away again.
"I told you, didn’t I? Don’t ask.
Just come with us."

Allura asked.

The Succubus answered.

Allura’s eyes changed.

Shadow waved her hand.
Allura smiled lightly.
She then nodded—
"Let’s go."
The women smiled.

Allura’s mouth twitched again.

Edda added with a wicked grin.

Aisha smiled sweetly.

Allura followed behind them, rubbing her belly, frowning, and trying to squeeze answers out of every single one.
But no matter who she asked—
Felberta.
Aisha.
Skyla.
Every woman she thought she would be able to get an answer out of—
Even Evane, who couldn’t even look her in the eyes anymore—
They all said the same thing.
"It’s a secret."
And Allura could only grit her teeth.
Because she knew they were enjoying this.
A month passed.
While the women talked, teased and took their anger out on each other, all while keeping an eye on everything that was happening in the Main Universe,
In another ridiculously large room, Nux woke up to silence.
For a full second, he didn’t move.
His eyes stayed half open, unfocused, as if his mind was still deciding whether he was dreaming or not.
Then he blinked.
And memory crashed into him like a warm wave.
He had passed out.
And no, this wasn’t like what happened with Shadow, where he only did what he did so Shadow wouldn’t hurt herself. This time—
He had actually passed out.
Nux stared at the ceiling in surprise, thinking hard about when was the last time he had passed out without a care in this world and... no answer came to his mind.
Then,
A slow grin spread across his face.
A grin of a man who had lost and enjoyed every second of it.
A quiet laugh slipped out of his throat.
He turned his head slightly, his tongue licking his lips like he could still taste the past.
The images in his mind were clear—very, very clear.
Too many hands.
Too many voices.
Too many smug faces.
Too many... hungry eyes.
He closed his eyes for a moment and chuckled again.
"Ridiculous..."
He said that out loud and yet—
His grin only grew.

He pushed himself up. The silk sheets slid down his waist. His black shirt was still on, but it was open, hanging loose on his shoulders like he had been too lazy to fix it. His chest was marked with faint lines that did not fade since he had stopped his body from healing on its own.
After all, it was only fun when there were still some marks left.
His hair was messy. His jaw looked sharper than ever before and his darker, calmer eyes somehow looked... more dangerous.
This man had rested for an entire month now, and that was after centuries of not resting at all.
Nux was... definitely a changed man now, and in his current form...
That change was only more... compelling.
He looked like the incarnation of seduction itself, a sin that learned how to smile.

Nux rolled his shoulders and stretched. The room responded to him instantly. The air turned warm, the space around him became stronger, even the light seemed to lean closer, as if the Universe itself wanted to make him look better.
He exhaled slowly, then glanced at his hand.
His fingers flexed.
His energy flowed smoothly.
And then he smirked.
"So it really took a month."
He spoke in an amused tone, almost proud.
And just as he was about to stand—
He felt it.
A small... ripple in his bond.
A ripple that showed... the change in his wives’ emotions.
And in an instant, his grin widened even further.
His wives had sensed him waking up.
He didn’t call them; he didn’t have to.
He simply... waited as he glanced at the door.
And in the next instant—
The door opened.
One by one, they walked in.
With the exact grins he had imagined them to have.
And those grins told him one thing: this wouldn’t be the last time these women would be rubbing this on him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2255: You gave me the best gift in the entire Universe.
paragraphs: The door opened.
One by one, the women walked in.
With the exact grins he had imagined them to have.
Grins that told him that they wouldn’t let him forget.
The women walked in like winners.
Like queens returning from war with trophies in their hands.

Skyla almost bounced, grinning ear to ear. Edda’s smile looked sinful. Vyriana’s eyes gleamed with smug pride. Astaria’s gaze was steady, but her lips were lifted. Rune looked like she wanted to laugh out loud. Lane was quiet, but her eyes said everything. Aeliana’s stare was sharp, almost daring him to speak first.
Felberta came in with calm steps, but even she had that tiny curve at the corner of her lips. The kind that only showed when she knew she had him.
The others were no different. They all had that same smug look on their faces, even Sharnoth.
Shadow walked in last, arms crossed, chin raised like she was about to announce a verdict.
And Allura... lingered near the back, half-hidden behind Aisha, like she wanted to be invisible.
Slowly, the women walked in and climbed on the bed.
The same bed where they had... done it all.
The bed was obviously enormous—wide enough for all of them to do... whatever they wanted.
Some women sat on the edge, some sat close. Some laid back carelessly and within seconds, the enormous bed was full.
Twenty wives.
One man.
Twenty-one bodies, in a single bed.
And the feeling in the room was loud even without words.
Victory.
Edda leaned forward first, eyes sparkling with mischief.
"Oh, look.
He’s awake,"
she said sweetly.
"Did you sleep well?"
Skyla giggled.
"A whole month.
Pathetic."
Vyriana clicked her tongue.
"Don’t be mean. He tried."
Rune chuckled.
"He tried, yes."
Aisha smiled in a way that wasn’t kind at all.
They were all grinning. All of them. Like they had agreed on it beforehand.
They weren’t just happy.
They were here to rub it in.
Nux’s smirk deepened.
He leaned back against the pillows, relaxed, one arm resting behind his head. He looked at them like a king watching his court pretend they weren’t obsessed.
"Yes, yes, I know."
He said calmly.
"Do you?"
Shadow’s grin widened.
Felberta didn’t speak, but the mischief was there, even in her eyes.
"Yes, I remember I lost."
Skyla puffed her cheeks.
"You lost badly."
Lyriana raised her hand like she was counting.
"Terribly,"
Thyra added, nodding seriously as if this was an official report.
"And we won,"
Even Aeliana was grinning ear to ear.
The bed seemed to grow warmer from all that smugness.
Nux let them have it for a few seconds. He watched their expressions, their body language, the way they sat just a little closer than normal.
It felt... good to see them ’work together’ like this.
It was... amusing.
But of course, he couldn’t let them have all of it either.
Therefore, he moved.
He sat forward, close enough that the room’s attention all fell on him. His open shirt fell wider, showing more of his chest.
He didn’t fix it.
He would be a fool if he did.
After all, in a moment like this, it was a weapon.
Then, he reached out and took Felberta’s hand gently, innocently even.
Felberta blinked once, but didn’t pull away.
Nux brought her knuckles to his lips, kissed them lightly, then looked up at her with a quiet smile.
"You look proud,"
He murmured.
"It suits you, you should wear this look more often."
"D-Don’t try to flirt your way out of this!"
Felberta tried to stay calm but her stutter gave her away.
Nux’s eyes flickered with amusement.
Then he shifted slightly and reached for Aeliana’s hand next, fingers sliding into hers like it was natural, like it was his birthright.
Aeliana’s gaze sharpened, but her grip tightened around his.
"Did you enjoy it?"
He asked.
"Of course I did."
The Vampire did not crack.
"That’s all I wanted."
He whispered softly as he kissed her hand as well.

Just like that, Nux continued to move. One by one, he reached everyone. He brushed past Skyla’s cheek with the back of his fingers. Skyla froze for half a second, then giggled like she hadn’t been boasting a moment ago.
He leaned near Rune and whispered something too low for others to hear. Rune’s confident look faltered, then she clicked her tongue and looked away, annoyed at herself.
Nux’s grin grew.
He wasn’t doing anything outrageous.
He was only doing what he always did.
Stealing their focus, taking control without using any force. He was using a weapon far stronger than any force.
And it worked.

His golden eyes turned purple as he looked at his wives with amused, seductive playfulness. His open shirt that did not hide his well-built chest and those strong abs only added to the damage as he crawled toward his women, slowly, deliberately, with the grin on his face never fading.
One by one, the smug looks softened.
The proud grins turned into something else.
The winners started acting like wives again.
Even Vyriana’s proud posture shifted, her eyes lingering on Nux longer than before. Astaria was no different, her calm gaze grew heavier, looking at Nux with... strong desire again.
When Nux brought his face dangerously close to her and then moved past her lips to her ear to whisper something, her body trembled and she looked down, her strong, proud face instantly turning red.
The women watched him like they were memorizing him again.
Edda, the one in charge of this operation, tried to keep her smug face, but her lips parted slightly in annoyance.
"Hey,"
She called out.
"That’s cheating!"
"Cheating?"
Nux tilted his head.
"You’re doing the thing!"
Edda complained. The worst part was that because Nux knew she was the one in charge, he hadn’t made a move on her yet.
That’s what annoyed her so much!
"What thing?"
Nux asked innocently.
"That thing where you make everyone forget what they were saying!"
Edda snorted.
And Nux...
His grin widened.
Then he leaned back again, right in the center of them, like he belonged there more than anyone.
The smugness was gone.
Not fully.
But enough.
He had broken their little victory parade in less than five minutes, then, he looked around the bed, eyes warm, voice smooth.
"Now,
Are we done boasting?"
"Hmph!"
Edda huffed.
Nux chuckled as he crawled toward her and placed his head on her thighs.
"Hmph!"
Edda snorted again, but this time, there was a small, satisfied look on her face as she cupped Nux’s jaw with her hand.
Nux smiled, then he glanced at the rest of the women present in the room.
"Let’s talk now, shall we?"
"As long as you don’t forget that you slept for an entire month.
An Entire MONTH.
That is not normal at all.
Hehe~"
Aisha giggled. The Succubus looked... absolutely adorable.
Nux chuckled as he stared at her, then—
"It is normal."
He answered as he glanced at all the women present in the room and—
"Especially when that many monsters attack a poor man at once."
"Poor?"
The women raised their eyebrows at those words.
Just... how shameless could one be?
"Let’s just talk."
Felberta simply gave in.
"What do you want to talk about?"
Nux asked curiously even though he already knew what it was about.
Felberta too played along and her gaze moved towards the side of the room.
Nux followed his wife’s gaze and there she was.
The one woman being... painfully silent, which was completely out of her character.
Allura Leander.
The Succubus wasn’t sitting with that amused, seductive smile like she normally did.
She was half behind Aisha, like she was using her as a shield. Only her head and one shoulder showed. Her eyes met Nux’s for half a second, then quickly looked away.
And Nux... he smiled.
After all, he knew what the woman was thinking.
She had betrayed everyone in the room, even him.
The news she was carrying was big, something they should all be celebrating together, but she... she hid it.
Even from Nux.
And now when she was finally facing Nux after everything was revealed...
She...
She couldn’t show him her face.
When Allura realized Nux was actually looking at her, she tightened her grip on Aisha’s sleeve like she was anchoring herself and completely moved behind her, dodging Nux’s eyes.
Nux looked at Aisha and the Succubus raised her hands.
"Don’t look at me. She chose me."
Nux laughed again.
Then he leaned forward a little in a teasing manner and—
"I sleep for a month and when I wake up, my seductive succubus is... embarrassed to face me?
Is this some sort of a game?"
Allura didn’t say anything, but Nux could sense she wanted to talk.
She wanted to talk... a lot.
And finally, his smile dropped and in a serious tone,
"What you did was wrong."
He spoke.
Then, he disappeared and appeared right in front of Allura, holding both her hands as he looked right into her eyes.
"You were the one who was wrong, so you do not get the chance to punish me."
Allura looked at Nux and he continued.
"I can face many things head-on in the Universe. Your silence is not one of them, Allura.
You should know that."
Allura gulped, her eyes turning moist.
She spoke, her voice cracking.
"I... I am sorry...
I was selfish..."
"It doesn’t matter.
They already punished you."
Nux spoke gently, as he glanced at his wives.
Then, a big, gentle, and kind smile appeared on his face as he knelt in front of her and looked at her belly—
"As for me,
You gave me the best gift in the entire Universe. You have no need to apologize to me."

He sat forward, close enough that the room’s attention all fell on him.
His open shirt fell wider, showing more of his chest.
He didn’t fix it.
He would be a fool if he did.
After all, in a moment like this, it was a weapon.
Then, he reached out and took Felberta’s hand gently, innocently even.
Felberta blinked once, but didn’t pull away.
Nux brought her knuckles to his lips, kissed them lightly, then looked up at her with a quiet smile.
"You look proud,"
He murmured.
"It suits you, you should wear this look more often."
"D-Don’t try to flirt your way out of this!"
Felberta tried to stay calm but her stutter gave her away.
Nux’s eyes flickered with amusement.
Then he shifted slightly and reached for Aeliana’s hand next, fingers sliding into hers like it was natural, like it was his birthright.
Aeliana’s gaze sharpened, but her grip tightened around his.
"Did you enjoy it?"
He asked.
"Of course I did."
The Vampire did not crack.
"That’s all I wanted."
He whispered softly as he kissed her hand as well.
Just like that, Nux continued to move.
One by one, he reached everyone.
He brushed past Skyla’s cheek with the back of his fingers.
Skyla froze for half a second, then giggled like she hadn’t been boasting a moment ago.
He leaned near Rune and whispered something too low for others to hear.
Rune’s confident look faltered, then she clicked her tongue and looked away, annoyed at herself.
Nux’s grin grew.
He wasn’t doing anything outrageous.
He was only doing what he always did.
Stealing their focus, taking control without using any force.
He was using a weapon far stronger than any force.
And it worked.
His golden eyes turned purple as he looked at his wives with amused, seductive playfulness.
His open shirt that did not hide his well-built chest and those strong abs only added to the damage as he crawled toward his women, slowly, deliberately, with the grin on his face never fading.
One by one, the smug looks softened.
The proud grins turned into something else.
The winners started acting like wives again.
Even Vyriana’s proud posture shifted, her eyes lingering on Nux longer than before.
Astaria was no different, her calm gaze grew heavier, looking at Nux with... strong desire again.
When Nux brought his face dangerously close to her and then moved past her lips to her ear to whisper something, her body trembled and she looked down, her strong, proud face instantly turning red.
The women watched him like they were memorizing him again.
Edda, the one in charge of this operation, tried to keep her smug face, but her lips parted slightly in annoyance.
"Hey,"
She called out.
"That’s cheating!"
"Cheating?"
Nux tilted his head.
"You’re doing the thing!"
Edda complained.
The worst part was that because Nux knew she was the one in charge, he hadn’t made a move on her yet.
That’s what annoyed her so much!
"What thing?"
Nux asked innocently.
"That thing where you make everyone forget what they were saying!"
Edda snorted.
And Nux...
His grin widened.
Then he leaned back again, right in the center of them, like he belonged there more than anyone.
The smugness was gone.
Not fully.
But enough.
He had broken their little victory parade in less than five minutes, then, he looked around the bed, eyes warm, voice smooth.
"Now,
Are we done boasting?"
"Hmph!"
Edda huffed.
Nux chuckled as he crawled toward her and placed his head on her thighs.
"Hmph!"
Edda snorted again, but this time, there was a small, satisfied look on her face as she cupped Nux’s jaw with her hand.
Nux smiled, then he glanced at the rest of the women present in the room.
"Let’s talk now, shall we?"
"As long as you don’t forget that you slept for an entire month.
An Entire MONTH.
That is not normal at all.
Hehe~"
Aisha giggled.
The Succubus looked... absolutely adorable.
Nux chuckled as he stared at her, then—
"It is normal."
He answered as he glanced at all the women present in the room and—
"Especially when that many monsters attack a poor man at once."
"Poor?"
The women raised their eyebrows at those words.
Just... how shameless could one be?
"Let’s just talk."
Felberta simply gave in.
"What do you want to talk about?"
Nux asked curiously even though he already knew what it was about.
Felberta too played along and her gaze moved towards the side of the room.
Nux followed his wife’s gaze and there she was.
The one woman being... painfully silent, which was completely out of her character.
Allura Leander.
The Succubus wasn’t sitting with that amused, seductive smile like she normally did.
She was half behind Aisha, like she was using her as a shield.
Only her head and one shoulder showed.
Her eyes met Nux’s for half a second, then quickly looked away.
And Nux... he smiled.
After all, he knew what the woman was thinking.
She had betrayed everyone in the room, even him.
The news she was carrying was big, something they should all be celebrating together, but she... she hid it.
Even from Nux.
And now when she was finally facing Nux after everything was revealed...
She...
She couldn’t show him her face.
When Allura realized Nux was actually looking at her, she tightened her grip on Aisha’s sleeve like she was anchoring herself and completely moved behind her, dodging Nux’s eyes.
Nux looked at Aisha and the Succubus raised her hands.
"Don’t look at me.
She chose me."
Nux laughed again.
Then he leaned forward a little in a teasing manner and—
"I sleep for a month and when I wake up, my seductive succubus is... embarrassed to face me?
Is this some sort of a game?"
Allura didn’t say anything, but Nux could sense she wanted to talk.
She wanted to talk... a lot.
And finally, his smile dropped and in a serious tone,
"What you did was wrong."
He spoke.
Then, he disappeared and appeared right in front of Allura, holding both her hands as he looked right into her eyes.
"You were the one who was wrong, so you do not get the chance to punish me."
Allura looked at Nux and he continued.
"I can face many things head-on in the Universe.
Your silence is not one of them, Allura.
You should know that."
Allura gulped, her eyes turning moist.
She spoke, her voice cracking.
I am sorry...
I was selfish..."
"It doesn’t matter.
They already punished you."
Nux spoke gently, as he glanced at his wives.
Then, a big, gentle, and kind smile appeared on his face as he knelt in front of her and looked at her belly—
"As for me,
You gave me the best gift in the entire Universe.
You have no need to apologize to me."

chapters.title: Chapter 2256: We cannot do that.
paragraphs: "As for me,
You gave me the best gift in the entire Universe, you have no need to apologize to me."
Nux spoke with a smile so gentle and beautiful that for a moment, the women—Allura and all others—froze.
That smile...
That was the exact smile they all wanted to be the reason for.
The exact smile they were all so distraught about when they found out Allura took that opportunity from them.
A smile they would... willingly give their all for.
"N-Nux..."
Allura called out with a stutter, her hands trembling as she held Nux’s hands even tighter. The emotions in her eyes were so intense she couldn’t even describe them.
That was when Felberta spoke—
"That gift is why we are here."
—taking Nux’s attention.
Nux slowly turned towards his first wife, and in her eyes, he saw coldness. It was extremely subtle, so well hidden that even the rest of the women sitting right beside Felberta did not notice it.
But Nux did.
And he understood it.

Like the other women, Felberta too wanted to be in Allura’s place, and seeing her getting his attention like this... even though Felberta cared about family more than anyone else, it was still a sight that stung her heart.
And Nux, he held Allura’s hands tightly, signaling that he would have a private conversation with her later, and then glanced at Felberta.
"The child?"
He asked.
"Mhm, Allura’s baby!"
Skyla spoke excitedly, her eyes shining strongly.
"We want to know what he will be."
Lane added quietly,
"What bloodline he will inherit? His traits, his potential...
We wish to know it all."
Vyriana spoke, her mind already coming up with... ’ideas.’
"Will he be a full Incubus?"
Rune asked bluntly.
"Or would he carry your... ridiculous mix?"
The Cat-woman spoke, not knowing how else to describe... whatever Nux was right now.
The rest of the women leaned forward as well, wanting to know the answer. After all, this wasn’t just about Allura; it was connected to them and their future children as well.
Even Shadow, who usually just messed around and knew most things, was the same—this was something even she did not know.
"So that’s what you all wish to know, huh..."
He muttered, staring at all his wives. Even Allura was now staring at him intensely, as if she were searching for answers on his face.
"That’s why you all came the instant I woke up."
He nodded to himself.
"That is correct."
The women nodded seriously.
And Nux—
He leaned back as he sat on the floor he was kneeling on and—
"Let’s see what happens, shall we?"
He answered.
The women blinked, and as if Nux knew what they were thinking, he just looked at them and—
"How am I supposed to know something like that?
We should just let nature take its course, don’t you think?"
And the moment the women realized that he had no intention of telling them, their mouths twitched in annoyance, all at the same time.
As for Nux not knowing the answer?
Not a single one of them bought that bullshit.
This was Nux they were talking about.
The man who was paranoid beyond belief.
It was HIS child.
His FIRST child.
Would someone like Nux not look into what his child would be? His potential? His bloodline? His health?
Someone like Nux wouldn’t be able to close his eyes if he didn’t know these answers, let alone tease and smile like he was right now.
Vyriana was currently so pissed she was considering throwing a rock at this bastard, but the dragon knew it would do absolutely nothing to this monster.
The worst part?
Seeing that grin on his face, it was clear he had arranged things so that even if they wanted to look for an answer, they wouldn’t find anything.
He... hewantedthem to remain curious.
This was... his sick way of getting back at them after he lost.
How ridiculous!
How petty!
The women clenched their fists in anger, thinking of ways they would get back at him, and Nux...
He grinned even more, extremely satisfied by the reactions he was seeing.
"Nux."
That was when Amaya called out in a calm tone but with a sharp look in her eyes. Nux turned towards her and tilted his head in curiosity.
Amaya’s mouth twitched, probably trying to stop her expression from faltering and falling for his teasing again,
And this time, the Devourer succeeded.
"That’s enough playing around.
Have you seen what’s happening in the Main Universe?"

In an instant, the room quietened. Even Edda, who had been whispering some nonsense into Skyla’s ear, stopped. Shadow leaned back a little, like she already knew what kind of conversation this was going to become.
Vyriana, Astaria and Aeliana too had solemn looks on their faces.
Amaya’s gaze stayed on Nux and she continued.
"Ever since the Four Infinities came together, information regarding the Anomaly has been spread.
His face, his abilities, and his... connections.
Everything is out now.
Everyone outside knows who you are.
Not just you; the mercenary records that we destroyed are now out, and the faces of the members of the Leander Family are exposed too.
The people are no longer hunting rumors...
They are coming for us."
Amaya spoke with a solemn look on her face, instantly killing the joyful mood of the room. After all, it was high time they returned to what actually mattered most right now.
The entire Universe was now against them. They needed to have a thorough discussion about how they were going to continue from here.
"And the ones leading them are the Four Infinities."
Amaya spoke directly.
Her sentence landed hard.
Even though the women had already heard it before, hearing it said like that made all this... much more serious.
After a long, heavy pause, Vyriana raised her voice.
"So what is the plan?"
The Dragon asked, looking not just at Nux but every single person inside, making sure everyone understood she wasn’t only asking Nux.
She was asking all of them.
And once again, there was silence.
After all, it wasn’t an easy question to answer.
The enemies they were facing were no longer leaders of small factions, some lands, continents, or even worlds...
Their enemies were the leaders of an entire Universe—beings so strong that even now, the limits of their strength were unknown.
The silence lasted a good, long while, until—
"We don’t have to leave our Universe anymore."
Aeliana spoke up with a serious look on her face. She then pointed at the room around them and—
"We have every Primordial Energy we wanted. Our Universe can now support life, it can grow on its own.Wecan grow on our own.
We no longer need the Main Universe.
We now have a home.
A place they cannot reach easily."
Her eyes flickered to the women around her—
"And now..."
Then her gaze landed on Allura’s belly, then shifted—one by one—to the others who carried the same, quiet change inside them.
"Now we have lives to protect."
Allura stiffened slightly, rubbing her belly out of habit.
Aeliana, on the other hand, nodded more strongly, her gaze becoming even firmer as she looked at Nux.
"We should stay here.
Let the Main Universe scream.
Let those people gather.
Let them waste their power looking for us."
Then, after a slight pause—
"Let them fail."
She declared arrogantly, as if sure that as long as they did not do anything foolish, the enemies would have no way of finding them.
But Nux...
"No."
He shook his head.
"We cannot do that."
He spoke simply, and Aeliana frowned, unable to understand.

Nux then stood up from the floor and slowly walked towards the window, staring outside at his Universe. His open shirt hung loose, but the faint traces of teeth and nails that he had kept all this while after pausing his healing began to vanish as the casual, playful air around him disappeared.
"Cosmic time is slow,"
He said slowly.
"Painfully slow."
He then turned back towards his wives, staring specifically at Aeliana.
"Yes, our Universe will grow on its own now. It will expand. It will deepen. It will become stronger.
But that won’t happen in months, years or... even centuries."
Nux’s tone sharpened ever so slightly and—
"It will take billions, trillions of years, maybe even more."
And the instant Nux said those words, the women became quiet. Some turned towards Shadow, almost as if wanting to confirm Nux’s words, and Shadow nodded.
It was something she knew as well.
Nux smiled at that and then continued,
"Our Universe is perfect in structure,
But it still has flaws."
"What flaws?"
Amaya asked.
"The biggest one?"
Nux glanced around the room and then—
"It still cannot support true individuals."
The women frowned at those words.
Cannot support true individuals?
How was that possible?
Didn’t they already have everything needed?
Then what was the issue now?
Was there something they... still lacked?

chapters.title: Chapter 2257: The Plan.
paragraphs: "Our Universe is perfect in structure,
But it still has flaws."
"What flaws?"
Amaya asked.
"The biggest one?"
Nux glanced around the room and then—
"It still cannot support true individuals."
The women frowned at those words, several questions appearing in their heads, and Nux, who could sense all those questions, began explaining.

"Our Universe can now support life, yes. This is the reason that billions of beings who became part of our Universe because we devoured their worlds have not become incomplete entities, but full ones.
But supporting life and giving birth to new life are two separate matters."
Nux paused, letting his words sink in.
"The Primordial Energies support the Universe. They help it expand, exist and give birth to life, but all of this takes time.
Cosmic-level time.
The energies gather, worlds form, the worlds then form their wills, and that’s when life sprouts.
And this takes a long, long time.
Our Universe, however, is different.
Our Universe already has worlds, and these worlds have their wills but... none of those wills are awake yet.
They are still... sleeping and adjusting to their new surroundings.
And that means..."
Nux paused, looking at Allura, then at the others with an even more serious look.
"That means our Universe is not ready to support new life the way it should."
Allura’s hand moved to her belly again without thinking.
Felberta’s expression tightened.
Evane’s frown deepened, her worry apparent. The question in her head was simple: if the Universe cannot support new life, then what about their child?
What was going to happen to their child?
And it wasn’t just her; every woman was thinking the same.
And Nux obviously knew that—
"A child doesn’t only need protection from enemies.
A child needs the Universe itself to hold, nourish him and... help him grow."
Then, Nux looked back at Aeliana and—
"So no.
Staying here and waiting is not enough."
Aeliana’s expression changed.
"You want to keep invading."
"Yes."
Nux nodded.
And a cold, unexpected silence followed.
"Devouring living entities from the Main Universe doesn’t just shift that entity from the Main Universe to ours.
It acts like fertilizer.
No matter what kind of living entity it is.

Living Worlds have their World Wills. When I devour those worlds together with their Will, I plant the seed of that very World Will in our Universe, erasing the need to form a new, independent world and a world’s will entirely. And while it does save quite a bit of energy, what it saves even more is time.
Creating everything from scratch takes far longer than just... letting the dormant seeds wake up.
And it’s not just the worlds, even the living beings we devour become nourishment. When these living beings break through, they make the Universe and myself more... stable and... stronger.
Their breakthrough acts as our Universe’s fertilizer. Of course, when one does it, it wouldn’t change anything, but when billions, trillions or even quadrillions do it—
The effect becomes much, much, much bigger.
With such a ridiculous amount of fertilizer, we could stabilize our Universe within decades and..."
Nux smiled again. It wasn’t his usual teasing smile; it was like a Dragon’s arrogant, stubborn smile that made it clear he had no intention of stepping back,
Not when he was doing all this for his child.
"That’s what I aim to do."
He declared directly.
"Even if the Four Infinities stand together against us."
"You really don’t know when to stop."
Ember sighed, already rubbing her temple. The Dragon seemed... amused and irritated at the same time.
Nux glanced at her and—
"I know exactly when to stop,"
He replied.
Then he glanced at the bellies again.
"And I’m not stopping now."
His voice grew gentler for a moment.
"Not when we finally have something that needs more than our strength.
Something that needs time, growth, and nourishment."
His eyes then sharpened again and—
"I have no intention of waiting trillions of years for that."
For a moment, no one spoke.
The air in the room felt heavier than before. The women’s faces turned solemn; it felt like the Universe itself had leaned forward to listen.
Felberta’s fingers rested on her belly and her eyes changed, becoming more... focused. She looked like she was already counting risks in her head.
Amaya’s gaze stayed locked on Nux. Even the Devourer did not like the idea of leaving their Universe again—not when they finally had a home, not when they now held something so fragile.
"So... what’s the plan?"
Aeliana asked carefully.
Her voice was calm, but every single person in the room felt the... tension in it.
And none of them found it strange. After all, this was indeed something they should discuss properly. So just like that, all the women pushed aside their relaxed thoughts and—
They all turned towards Nux with solemn looks on their faces.
Nux looked at all of them.
He looked at their faces, then he looked at their bellies again and... his smile returned. A calm, confident smile, like he had already prepared everything that was going to happen in the future.
"We do what we have been doing all this while,"
He answered.
The women stared at him, waiting for him to continue. Nux’s grin widened even further, and the look in his eyes became sharp, almost... predatory.
"Only that now,"
He said in a low, amused voice,
"We do an even better job."
The women’s frowns deepened.
They did not like the look on Nux’s face one bit. It was the same look they saw every time Nux stood in front of an enemy he could not defeat.
The same look that filled them with... excitement but now, with the heavy responsibilities on their shoulders...
"Nux—"
Amaya tried to talk, to reason.
But Nux simply placed a finger on her lips, silencing her with a small, teasing smile, then—
"Let me finish."
He whispered softly and, just like that—
He began to talk, explaining everything he was planning.
And as his calm, confident, detailed voice filled the room, the women leaned in, one by one. The bed creaked softly under their weight.
The air shifted as if the Universe itself listened and then—
The women’s expressions started changing, from tense to... dangerously amused smiles.
It was almost as if they were looking forward to seeing what was going to happen.
And far away, in an entirely different Universe—the Main Universe—

It was merely a blink.

He vanished.
