chapters.title: Chapter 2291: WAR.
paragraphs: "Alright."
Azriel nodded as he then closed his eyes and—
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
The Universe reacted in anger like it usually does when the Anomaly attacks.

Or at least, that’s how it felt to the Infinities. Soon, however, their expressions changed as they realized something. It wasn’t the entire Universe that was trembling, no, it was something... much calmer.
It was only the space they were in.
Space that... no one should know about.
Space that... no being should be able to sense.
Except...
Except for the Universe’s Will itself.
As the Universe’s Will, as long as it was not hidden inside an Infinity’s Domain, it was almost impossible for anyone to hide anything from the Universe’s eyes.

The Infinities’ Dimension was no different, it wasn’t hidden from the Universe’s Will. Of course, the Infinities had the resources to hide it, they just didn’t bother since no one could access the Universe’s Will and find them.
No one had that ability, no one other than... a Universe’s Child.
And if the Fifth was somehow targeting just the space they were in, it meant he knew where they were and if he knew that then...
That makes the Fifth the... Universe’s Child.
The realization kicked in almost instantly and the Infinities... for a good few seconds, they froze.
They knew that the Universe had chosen its ’Hero’ not long ago. All this while, they had been doubting each other.
Out of the Four, Seraphielle was completely out of the picture since she could instantly use that power to get rid of the Anomaly, but the other three were still suspects in each other’s eyes.
The thought of someone else having that power, well, it did come to their minds but in their arrogance, none of them considered that possibility for long.
And now...
Now the Universe’s Child was standing right in front of them.
And if the Fifth was the Universe’s Child... then that makes the Anomaly, the Universe’s sole enemy, his enemy as well.
The Fifth and the Anomaly couldn’t be allies, this proves it.
And now that it has been proven...
Slowly, the three Infinities turned towards... Orravyn.
Orravyn stood still, not knowing what he was supposed to say. He had planned to counter anything Azriel said or showed but this...
This couldn’t be countered.
His powers were real, and a Universe’s Child couldn’t possibly be together with the Universe’s Enemy, not when their lives and powers are connected to each other.
Then...
The fingers were now pointed at him, the one who had been pointing his finger at the Fifth the most.
"Orravyn."
Seraphielle was the first to call out.
Orravyn looked at her and didn’t say anything, he just stared at her, trying to read her face. Before she could say anything, however—
"Have I proven myself now?"
Azriel asked without any change in his expression. He waved his hand and the shaking stopped. Then he looked at Orravyn and—
"This is why I do not trust any one of you.
Because if I do reveal myself, I know what you lot will do."
"So you are scared."
Ul’Thakar grinned.
"I simply do not like having a target on my back."
"Grand words for someone who was talking about dragons, wolves, mortals and gods."
Ul’Thakar didn’t let it go, he just grinned.
"For someone who had been with the Universe since its beginning and still wasn’t chosen by it, you speak an awful lot as well."
Azriel chuckled.
Ul’Thakar wanted to say something, but there was honestly nothing he could say, so he stayed silent.
Azriel shrugged, then he looked at the other Infinities and—
"Anyways, I have proven myself now. I am not with the Anomaly, neither do I know much about him. What you do with this information, whether you believe it or not, it doesn’t matter.
I contacted you because I felt you needed my help, but clearly—"
Azriel glanced at Ul’Thakar and—
"You do not.
You must be able to handle this yourself or maybe..."
The Universe’s Child then glanced at Seraphielle and—
"Maybe I am ruining some of your plans and am being a hindrance. So I will excuse myself. If you wish to contact me then—
I wish you luck. I do not like being bothered so I probably won’t answer again."
With those words, the screen disappeared.
Azriel broke the contact, leaving the room silent.
"What did he mean by ruining someone’s plan...?"
Equarios narrowed his eyes as he glanced at Seraphielle with a suspicious look on his face. Seraphielle, however, just snorted.
"Has time had an effect on you or are you acting ignorant on purpose?"
She asked as she glared at Orravyn and—
"Is it not obvious what he was trying to say?"
Hearing those words, Equarios turned towards Orravyn too.
The Anomaly...

If they thought about it properly and recalled previous conversations, every single time, one way or the other, Orravyn took the lead, and even though he usually dealt with problems like this quite early, in the Anomaly’s case...
They did not have even a single lead, everything they knew about it was merely speculation, speculation Orravyn made and... no one knew if it was true or not...
It was... definitely suspicious.
It was almost as if... Orravyn was purposefully misguiding them.
Orravyn understood what the other three were thinking and he—
"You should understand it as well. I was set up."
He tried to defend himself.
"Think of it yourself.
Why contact us only now?
He is the Universe’s Child, he is supposed to be its savior and yet...
The Anomaly has been devouring worlds for years now and he hasn’t done anything to stop him. He doesn’t even seem like he cares, how could the Universe choose him?
He must have fooled the Universe using some kind of trickery, trickery he is using against us as well.
Do not fall for it, I firmly believe that he and the Anomaly are together in this. This must be their attempt to create a rift between us. You must no—"
"Orravyn."

Before Orravyn could complete his sentence, Seraphielle called out and this time, there was no trace of warmth in her tone. Her eyes looked... empty, it was like she was staring at the enemy who had killed or taken away everything she desired.
"Seraphielle—"
"Stop it."
Seraphielle waved her hand.
"The truth does not matter.
A lie replaces the truth if it is backed by evidence.
He gave his, you have not.
You should understand what that means."
"Do you truly believe I am together with the Anomaly?"
Orravyn asked directly, wanting to counter in one way or another and Seraphielle—
"Would you not have if it were you?"
She asked and Orravyn...
He couldn’t answer.
No, more accurately, he knew the answer, he just... couldn’t say it out loud since it wouldn’t work in his favor. Not that the situation was in his favor right now either.
"Seraphielle, I am not working with the Anomaly."
He tried to say it, to somehow make her believe him but Seraphielle—
"It doesn’t matter."
Seraphielle declared.
"In this game of who is responsible and who is not, it is me and my Faction that is paying the price.
One of you three is working together with the Anomaly, I do not know who it is, neither do I care.
I need this to stop.
I need the Universe to know that Light is not an easy target that anyone can point fingers at.
Seraphielle paused and then—
"I need compensation."
She demanded boldly.
"Compensation...?"
Orravyn frowned and Seraphielle nodded—
"I lost a decent amount of strength and your factions swallowed my worlds, you know that as well. It is time you take responsibility and compensate for that lost strength."

The room fell silent, the three Infinities looked at Seraphielle like she had lost her mind. The change was too sudden, just a few minutes ago, she was talking to the Fifth, and even when he pushed her buttons, she did not lose her calm.
But now...
Now it seemed like she was ready to go to war if that’s what it took.
"What compensation?"
Orravyn asked, he still needed more time, time to understand what was happening, what Seraphielle was planning and to come up with an answer.
Seraphielle paused for a moment, almost as if she was thinking about how to answer. In her mind, however, she was having an entirely different conversation.
’We are prepared.’
And the moment that message came, Seraphielle hid her smile before it even reached her face and looked right into Orravyn’s eyes.
"Hundred Supreme Borns."
She demanded.
Then she looked at the other two Infinities and—
"From all of you."
And in an instant—
The Infinities lost their calm.
"WHAT!?"
Ul’Thakar was the first to react.
"Have you lost your mind!?"
"You captured about twenty of my worlds,
I think I am being more than fair."
Seraphielle did not back down.
"You lost your worlds, we did not take them from you. Don’t blame your incompetence on us!"
Ul’Thakar snapped.
"So I take it you refuse?"
Seraphielle asked.
"Yes.
I refuse."
Ul’Thakar answered in a heavy voice and Seraphielle, her gaze hardened—
"Do not blame me then."
She spoke, then—
BOOOOOOOOOOM
Her Aura exploded and her voice echoed throughout the Universe—
"I, Seraphielle Light, declare war on Ul’Thakar Darkness and the Darkness Faction."
It happened.

sentences.text: "Alright."
Azriel nodded as he then closed his eyes and—
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
The Universe reacted in anger like it usually does when the Anomaly attacks.
Or at least, that’s how it felt to the Infinities.
Soon, however, their expressions changed as they realized something.
It wasn’t the entire Universe that was trembling, no, it was something... much calmer.
It was only the space they were in.
Space that... no one should know about.
Space that... no being should be able to sense.
Except...
Except for the Universe’s Will itself.
As the Universe’s Will, as long as it was not hidden inside an Infinity’s Domain, it was almost impossible for anyone to hide anything from the Universe’s eyes.
The Infinities’ Dimension was no different, it wasn’t hidden from the Universe’s Will.
Of course, the Infinities had the resources to hide it, they just didn’t bother since no one could access the Universe’s Will and find them.
No one had that ability, no one other than... a Universe’s Child.
And if the Fifth was somehow targeting just the space they were in, it meant he knew where they were and if he knew that then...
That makes the Fifth the...
Universe’s Child.
The realization kicked in almost instantly and the Infinities... for a good few seconds, they froze.
They knew that the Universe had chosen its ’Hero’ not long ago.
All this while, they had been doubting each other.
Out of the Four, Seraphielle was completely out of the picture since she could instantly use that power to get rid of the Anomaly, but the other three were still suspects in each other’s eyes.
The thought of someone else having that power, well, it did come to their minds but in their arrogance, none of them considered that possibility for long.
And now...
Now the Universe’s Child was standing right in front of them.
And if the Fifth was the Universe’s Child... then that makes the Anomaly, the Universe’s sole enemy, his enemy as well.
The Fifth and the Anomaly couldn’t be allies, this proves it.
And now that it has been proven...
Slowly, the three Infinities turned towards...
Orravyn.
Orravyn stood still, not knowing what he was supposed to say.
He had planned to counter anything Azriel said or showed but this...
This couldn’t be countered.
His powers were real, and a Universe’s Child couldn’t possibly be together with the Universe’s Enemy, not when their lives and powers are connected to each other.
Then...
The fingers were now pointed at him, the one who had been pointing his finger at the Fifth the most.
"Orravyn."
Seraphielle was the first to call out.
Orravyn looked at her and didn’t say anything, he just stared at her, trying to read her face.
Before she could say anything, however—
"Have I proven myself now?"
Azriel asked without any change in his expression.
He waved his hand and the shaking stopped.
Then he looked at Orravyn and—
"This is why I do not trust any one of you.
Because if I do reveal myself, I know what you lot will do."
"So you are scared."
Ul’Thakar grinned.
"I simply do not like having a target on my back."
"Grand words for someone who was talking about dragons, wolves, mortals and gods."
Ul’Thakar didn’t let it go, he just grinned.
"For someone who had been with the Universe since its beginning and still wasn’t chosen by it, you speak an awful lot as well."
Azriel chuckled.
Ul’Thakar wanted to say something, but there was honestly nothing he could say, so he stayed silent.
Azriel shrugged, then he looked at the other Infinities and—
"Anyways, I have proven myself now.
I am not with the Anomaly, neither do I know much about him.
What you do with this information, whether you believe it or not, it doesn’t matter.
I contacted you because I felt you needed my help, but clearly—"
Azriel glanced at Ul’Thakar and—
"You do not.
You must be able to handle this yourself or maybe..."
The Universe’s Child then glanced at Seraphielle and—
"Maybe I am ruining some of your plans and am being a hindrance.
So I will excuse myself.
If you wish to contact me then—
I wish you luck.
I do not like being bothered so I probably won’t answer again."
With those words, the screen disappeared.
Azriel broke the contact, leaving the room silent.
"What did he mean by ruining someone’s plan...?"
Equarios narrowed his eyes as he glanced at Seraphielle with a suspicious look on his face.
Seraphielle, however, just snorted.
"Has time had an effect on you or are you acting ignorant on purpose?"
She asked as she glared at Orravyn and—
"Is it not obvious what he was trying to say?"
Hearing those words, Equarios turned towards Orravyn too.
The Anomaly...

If they thought about it properly and recalled previous conversations, every single time, one way or the other, Orravyn took the lead, and even though he usually dealt with problems like this quite early, in the Anomaly’s case...
They did not have even a single lead, everything they knew about it was merely speculation, speculation Orravyn made and... no one knew if it was true or not...
It was... definitely suspicious.
It was almost as if...
Orravyn was purposefully misguiding them.
Orravyn understood what the other three were thinking and he—
"You should understand it as well.
I was set up."
He tried to defend himself.
"Think of it yourself.
Why contact us only now?
He is the Universe’s Child, he is supposed to be its savior and yet...
The Anomaly has been devouring worlds for years now and he hasn’t done anything to stop him.
He doesn’t even seem like he cares, how could the Universe choose him?
He must have fooled the Universe using some kind of trickery, trickery he is using against us as well.
Do not fall for it, I firmly believe that he and the Anomaly are together in this.
This must be their attempt to create a rift between us.
You must no—"
"Orravyn."
Before Orravyn could complete his sentence, Seraphielle called out and this time, there was no trace of warmth in her tone.
Her eyes looked... empty, it was like she was staring at the enemy who had killed or taken away everything she desired.
"Seraphielle—"
"Stop it."
Seraphielle waved her hand.
"The truth does not matter.
A lie replaces the truth if it is backed by evidence.
He gave his, you have not.
You should understand what that means."
"Do you truly believe I am together with the Anomaly?"
Orravyn asked directly, wanting to counter in one way or another and Seraphielle—
"Would you not have if it were you?"
She asked and Orravyn...
He couldn’t answer.
No, more accurately, he knew the answer, he just... couldn’t say it out loud since it wouldn’t work in his favor.
Not that the situation was in his favor right now either.
"Seraphielle, I am not working with the Anomaly."
He tried to say it, to somehow make her believe him but Seraphielle—
"It doesn’t matter."
Seraphielle declared.
"In this game of who is responsible and who is not, it is me and my Faction that is paying the price.
One of you three is working together with the Anomaly, I do not know who it is, neither do I care.
I need this to stop.
I need the Universe to know that Light is not an easy target that anyone can point fingers at.
Seraphielle paused and then—
"I need compensation."
She demanded boldly.
"Compensation...?"
Orravyn frowned and Seraphielle nodded—
"I lost a decent amount of strength and your factions swallowed my worlds, you know that as well.
It is time you take responsibility and compensate for that lost strength."
The room fell silent, the three Infinities looked at Seraphielle like she had lost her mind.
The change was too sudden, just a few minutes ago, she was talking to the Fifth, and even when he pushed her buttons, she did not lose her calm.
But now...
Now it seemed like she was ready to go to war if that’s what it took.
"What compensation?"
Orravyn asked, he still needed more time, time to understand what was happening, what Seraphielle was planning and to come up with an answer.
Seraphielle paused for a moment, almost as if she was thinking about how to answer.
In her mind, however, she was having an entirely different conversation.
’We are prepared.’
And the moment that message came, Seraphielle hid her smile before it even reached her face and looked right into Orravyn’s eyes.
"Hundred Supreme Borns."
She demanded.
Then she looked at the other two Infinities and—
"From all of you."
And in an instant—
The Infinities lost their calm.
"WHAT!?"
Ul’Thakar was the first to react.
"Have you lost your mind!?"
"You captured about twenty of my worlds,
I think I am being more than fair."
Seraphielle did not back down.
"You lost your worlds, we did not take them from you.
Don’t blame your incompetence on us!"
Ul’Thakar snapped.
"So I take it you refuse?"
Seraphielle asked.
"Yes.
I refuse."
Ul’Thakar answered in a heavy voice and Seraphielle, her gaze hardened—
"Do not blame me then."
She spoke, then—
BOOOOOOOOOOM
Her Aura exploded and her voice echoed throughout the Universe—
"I, Seraphielle Light, declare war on Ul’Thakar Darkness and the Darkness Faction."
It happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 2292: It was already over.
paragraphs: "So I take it you refuse?"

Seraphielle asked as she stared at Ul’Thakar. She obviously knew how unreasonable she currently sounded, one might even think that she had lost herself in her anger and had been manipulated by the Fifth Infinity.
But...
That was far from the case.
Seraphielle had been planning this long before she even knew the Fifth would finally contact them.

When the Fifth actually did, for a moment, she felt frustrated. She feared he would get involved, and dealing with an uncertainty as big as another Infinity level in any plan was... well, one could say it wasn’t a good idea.
You don’t ’just go for it’ when it comes to Infinities. Even a single odd move from them could change the entire situation and you needed to be very careful, and that is when you have a plan.
And if you don’t have a plan that takes the accurate number of Infinities into the equation, you stop right there.
Or at least... that’s how it usually happens.
Seraphielle was prepared to drop her plans, but that was when the Fifth opened his mouth and Seraphielle understood what he was trying to do.
The Fifth too wanted to create a rift between the Infinities, probably to use that moment of weakness to his advantage and solidify his position in the Universe.
A viable plan, chaos was a threat to the weak, but for the strong, it was a way to strengthen themselves, and that was exactly what the Fifth wanted.
As for Seraphielle?
It was a win for her too, her worlds were already being attacked, the pressure was high, her Faction was thinning down, if this continued, it was only a matter of time before her faction disappeared.
Yes, the situation had become that difficult. After all, there was no certain way to catch the Anomaly.
He was too evasive, he was... too difficult for Seraphielle to deal with alone.
So she...
So she needed to do something, something that... would leave a strong impact on the entire Universe.
A deadly attack that almost cripples one of the four Supreme Factions was definitely an answer.
Would it make an Infinity her enemy?
Yes, of course.
But weren’t all Infinities enemies already?
Under that guise of alliance and coming together to save the Universe bullshit, the Infinities were all trying to tear each other apart.
She wasn’t doing anything different.
Why go this far? What’s the point?
It was simple.

Seraphielle could not beg for help, that was beneath her, but the fact that she couldn’t deal with the Anomaly alone, especially if he doesn’t appear right in front of her and continues to avoid her, couldn’t be ignored either.
She needed the help of the other Infinities to deal with it.
How do you get help without actually asking for it?
Well...
You make others feel what you are feeling.
And Seraphielle felt... desperation. A strong sense of helplessness. An overwhelming sense of powerlessness, so strong that she...
She decided to make the final, ultimate move.
She would attack.

She would wage war strong enough to burn the very Universe itself. At first, others would enjoy it, they would think that she and the Infinity she was facing would go at each other and perish, leaving this long, long game—

But the battles of two Infinities were seldom only the two Infinities fighting. Sooner or later, others would join too, they would have to since they would never know when everything might fall to ruin and the rest of the Infinities come together and attack them instead.

Yes, that was the plan, to involve all the Infinities in the battle, plunge the Universe into pure, utter chaos and continue this until either one of the Infinities comes forward to stop the battle and the chaos that came with it, fearing what the Anomaly and other beings from other Universes might do.
Or...
Of course, she perishes.
Which was highly likely as well.
She could already see Darkness, Eternity and Balance coming together to fight her, that was actually the most ideal way to deal with this situation.
But if that happens—
Seraphielle had decided that she would either perish or...
Or she would join the Anomaly.
Yes, she would go against the very Universe itself if it meant she could survive and come out on top.
Would that be seen as betrayal? Or her giving in to the Anomaly?
Maybe.
But what would a Universe that would then be her enemy even matter?
As for her giving in to the Anomaly...
It was only a matter of time, since once she gets close to him, she very much plans to learn more about his secrets, the source of his powers and once she has his trust—
She was going to end his life as well and take away everything he cherished.
Then she would not just be the Absolute Ruler of her own Universe, but also of the Anomaly’s Universe, that was clearly more advanced than their own.
What if all of this didn’t go according to her plan?

What if this was exactly what the Anomaly had been waiting for? What if the war becomes a trigger? What if the Anomaly uses this chance to bring his actual army and take over their then-weakened Universe?
Then they just lose.
Seraphielle did not mind, she was already losing in the first place. She would much rather lose to enemies she does not know or recognize than fall before any of her... ’friends’ do.
She did not wish to be remembered as the first Infinity that fell in the great war.
She did not wish to become... the previous Eternity.
With all those thoughts being very, very clear in her mind—
Seraphielle looked at Ul’Thakar, waiting for an answer and Ul’Thakar did not make her wait for long.
He had no idea what the woman was playing at, he too could sense that something was wrong, that this wasn’t her ideal behaviour, that she wouldn’t do something so foolish without a plan but...
He didn’t give a fuck.
He only saw a simple thing, Seraphielle was trying to push him around, she was trying to provoke him and he—
He had to answer.
So that’s what he did.
"Yes.
I refuse."
He answered, looking right into Seraphielle’s eyes as if he was prepared for anything that might follow.
Seraphielle’s gaze hardened—
"Do not blame me then."
She spoke as suddenly—
BOOOOOOOOOOM

The entire room trembled violently, the walls, the walls that were made from the strongest materials in the existence of the Universe, materials even Eternals would have a hard time breaking, those same walls began to crack like they were mirrors being hammered.
A pressure so suffocatingly high engulfed the entire room, the four Infinities stood still. Obviously, the pressure did not push them down, they were more than strong enough to resist it.
Their eyes, however, were fixed on her.
And Seraphielle—
She looked at Ul’Thakar with her golden eyes now glowing intensely and—
"I, Seraphielle Light, declare War on Ul’Thakar Darkness and the Darkness Faction."
And it happened.
Seraphielle Light declared war.
Her words, carried by the Universe itself, echoed through every single corner, the Light Faction, the Darkness Faction, no place in the Universe was left untouched.
The people who heard those words froze, outright wars stopped that very instant because that declaration meant something far greater than their very existence was happening.
Something that would change the course of the Universe.
Some were surprised too, unable to understand why this was happening all of a sudden, especially when Light itself should be busy dealing with the Anomaly.
However—
Not everyone had the luxury to worry, be surprised, confused, or even be fearful.
Because Seraphielle’s words weren’t just a declaration for the Universe and its people—
It was also a signal.
A signal for Lord Light to move.
And that was exactly what he did, the moment he heard her words, the target that they had been waiting for was now clear.
Out of the three plans the Light Army was given, one was finally chosen and—
[Move]
Lord Light ordered his men and—
It happened.
In an instant, mass teleportation crystals, forgotten relics that were only used in Supreme Wars, artifacts and weapons that would make even the High-Level Worlds greedy—
They were all activated.
And Light’s strongest army arrived at Darkness’s core worlds, worlds that were very strongly protected but...
Light was just more prepared.

Everything was planned so perfectly that it was almost scary. Worlds with eight Eternals defending them were attacked by twelve Eternals, six were attacked by eight, four with six, two with three and one with two.
How was it possible? Especially when Light had lost a considerable amount of Eternals after the Anomaly had constantly targeted them for years?
The answer to that was simple, Light did not attack every single High-Level World, only the important worlds, the worlds that could be considered Darkness’s Pillars were attacked.
And to achieve that—
ALL of Light’s Eternals were used. Other than the Supreme World of Light, no world that belonged to the Light Faction now had Eternals protecting it.
Even worse?
The attackers had far, far stronger weapons, weapons they were given directly from Light’s treasury.
This...
This wasn’t a battle the Darkness worlds that were attacked could win, no matter what they did.
The enemy was simply too prepared, not to mention quick.
By the time they had time to react—
It was already over.

chapters.title: Chapter 2293: Battle of Infinities.
paragraphs: "Seraphielle!"
"Have you lost your mind!?"
The moment the Infinity of Light declared war, the room reacted. Both Equarios and Orravyn raised their ’concerned’ voices.
A war between Light and Darkness wasn’t uncommon. Light Worlds were constantly at war with Darkness Worlds, it happened almost every century.
But a war between the Supreme World of Light and the Supreme World of Darkness?
That changed things.
Because that war would plunge the entire Universe into it.
And the two Infinities were worried.
Or at least, that’s what they were showing outside. Inwardly, however, they couldn’t be more glad.
The Anomaly had disrupted the delicate balance that the four Infinities had. His actions had spread fear, anger, helplessness and more such negative emotions.
These actions alone weakened Light, but with Light’s counter moves, moves like sealing themselves and monthly memory checks, these emotions only got stronger.

Light was severely weakened, it wasn’t just its Authority that was draining, the number of Eternals under Light’s Faction was falling and believe it or not, even if an Infinity was strong, the number of Eternals still mattered.
At least when it came to war.
But...
Light’s weakening wasn’t the only thing that happened because of this.
Light and Darkness were two opposite sides of the same coin, if Light got weaker, the chances of Darkness getting stronger were quite high.
And that was exactly what happened.
All this fear, uncertainty, helplessness, anger, negative emotions that the entire Universe felt fuelled Darkness, or more precisely, it strengthened Ul’Thakar.
Of course, he still wasn’t at the level where Zylarith once was. Darkness wasn’t like Chaos, it couldn’t grow endlessly.
But even then—
It wouldn’t be wrong to say that at this point in time, because of everything that was happening in the Universe, Ul’Thakar was the strongest out of the four of them.
And the worst part?
He was getting stronger and stronger.
If the Anomaly’s actions continued for... say another few hundred thousand years, at the same rate as he was doing right now, and none of his actions directly targeted Ul’Thakar...
The negative emotions in the Universe would pile up even further, releasing enough darkness energy to rival... chaos.
Yes.
If things continued like they were—
Ul’Thakar could potentially become as strong as Zylarith and none of the Infinities wanted that.
So while both Orravyn and Equarios talked about how they should avoid war and were trying to stop Seraphielle—
Inwardly, they were smiling.
The plan was simple.

They were going to let these two fight and weaken each other. Seraphielle’s condition did not matter, she was already out of the equation, at least for now, but they did hope that this war would weaken Ul’Thakar to some level, giving them an advantage.
Then they would only need to worry about each other and once the victor between them was chosen, he could then plan to move, find and defeat the Fifth and...
Take over the Universe’s Will.
Yes.
The Infinities, especially the Infinity of Balance and the Infinity of Eternity, could see it. Their long waits finally bearing fruit.
Of course, none of these feelings could be seen on their faces right now, they had even approached Seraphielle to try and stop her.
"Seraphielle, think carefully. This isn’t a battle you can win."

"Yes, stop this."
He nodded.
"Ul’Thakar is stronger than he normally is and you are weaker. If you continue like this, you will perish."

"War is not the solution!"

Their intentions were to provoke her, to boil her anger further, to make sure she didn’t back out, not now, not after they were so close.

Or at least that’s what they thought but—
"YOU!!"
BOOOOOOOOOOOM

Suddenly, Ul’Thakar, who had been silent for about a second, suddenly released an Aura far more suffocating than Seraphielle’s. His crimson eyes glowed intensely, pressure around him flared and he glared at Seraphielle as if he wanted her dead this very moment.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM

Seraphielle did not back down either, she released her Aura as well, this time without holding back. The two Auras clashed, both equally intense and the clash was so explosive that even the other two Infinities felt it.
In an instant, the giant room became a battlefield. Light and Darkness, the strongest forms of two completely opposite energies collided and...
The space shattered.
That very instant.
The two beings hadn’t even begun the battle and the destruction that came with it could already be seen.
Even the space that was hardened by the Infinities’ Auras shattered in an instant. The collision between Light and Darkness gave birth to...
An unknown matter.
A translucent, whitish-silver-purplish matter that ate everything it came into contact with at a pace so quick that even black holes seemed... like childish toys in comparison.

Orravyn observed that matter carefully. This obviously wasn’t the first time he had seen it, he had even tried to replicate it, to somehow use it because he knew whatever this... thing was, it was strong enough to hurt even the Infinities.
But it couldn’t be replicated, after all, the ’materials’ required to create it were... two of the strongest beings in the Universe.
Soon however, Orravyn shook his head, this wasn’t important right now, what he needed to understand was...
What in the hell was happening here?
Seraphielle, he understood. She was desperate, she was angry and that anger had piled up and burst out when the Fifth provoked her.
But...
What just happened to Ul’Thakar?
His frown deepened, then the reports finally came and the moment they did, he looked at Seraphielle with a shocked look on his face.
This woman...
She didn’t do it out of anger or helplessness...
It was planned.
She planned the entire thing and she...
She had already executed her plan.

All of Darkness’s major worlds had been attacked, some had perished. Yes, it had all begun just two seconds ago but Darkness’s worlds had already begun to perish, and these weren’t weak worlds, they were strongly protected.
And even those that had survived until now weren’t any better. Orravyn’s people had begun investigating the matter and they could see that the battle...
It wasn’t in Ul’Thakar’s favor at all.

Only Ul’Thakar’s own world, the Supreme World of Darkness, was faring well. The number of Light Borns was less compared to the number of Darkness Borns after the Anomaly hunted almost two hundred of them.
Sure, that gap was filled by the absurdly strong weapons the Light Borns were using, but the Darkness Borns were still holding on.
The Supreme World of Darkness was holding on.
But the rest of the worlds in the Darkness Faction were not.
The enemy was too prepared, they were caught completely off guard and the longer this continued, the more Darkness worlds would perish.
Ul’Thakar...
He needed to leave and stabilize the situation, right now.
But—
Seraphielle obviously wouldn’t allow that, so the Infinity of Light moved directly towards Ul’Thakar and with her sword now in her hand, she attacked.
Darkness formed his own sword out of the Darkness around him and blocked her attack.
The Gold and Black collided, once again that unknown matter was formed, this time in a much larger quantity than before and—
BOOOOOOOOM
The entire space blew up.

Both Orravyn and Equarios actually had to use their own Auras to protect themselves. Orravyn checked, he tried to regenerate the room they were in but just as he expected, the entire room was vaporized.
Nothing was left to be regenerated.
It was gone, together with the very space around them.
CLANK CLANK CLANK
The two Infinities continued to clash with their swords and with every single one of their clashes—
BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM
Explosions strong enough to hurt even Infinities if they weren’t careful exploded all over the place. The space was torn apart so many times that its very layers began to feel empty.
It was... damaged.
And it would take billions of years for the Universe to be able to heal this damage.
And mind you, not even five seconds had passed since it all began, since Seraphielle declared war and Ul’Thakar accepted.
That was the level of destruction that happened when Infinities fought.
That was why they say that when the Infinities fight, even the Universe bleeds.
And that was exactly what was happening right now.

The Universe’s Will was screaming, wanting the two beings to stop. At the same time, it kept reinforcing the void again and again, making sure that the very void that keeps everything together and gives birth to the concepts of Space, Time and other Primordial Energies didn’t get torn apart.
And while all this was happening—
Another being, standing far, far, far away from all this mess—
He observed it all with his golden eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 2294: It is time to move.
paragraphs: CLANK CLANK CLANK
BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM
Two of the strongest beings in the Universe clashed against each other, and the entire Universe felt the impact.
Of course, the Universe was constantly reinforcing the space and the void, making sure that the battle didn’t have too strong of an effect on its surroundings.
This obviously wasn’t the first battle between the Infinities. The Universe had seen quite a few, hell, it had experienced a full-blown war between all five Infinities back in the day.
So yes, the Universe knew how it was supposed to prepare for war, how to keep the damage to a minimum and how to survive, it just...
Didn’t wish to spend the resources it needed to spend to do that.

Not when there was another being that had been constantly devouring its resources all this while. Not that it had any choice. The battle had barely started and the amount of destruction made it clear that reinforcing was absolutely necessary.

Explosion after explosion, even the worlds that weren’t directly related to the battle, the worlds that were far, far away from it, were being affected by it and were shaking constantly. If the level of damage was spreading this far, then by the end of the battle, trillions of worlds would perish and the Universe couldn’t allow that.
So yes, it had to spend resources, no matter how much it cried.

And it wasn’t just the Universe’s Will that was being affected, the rest of the worlds, the worlds that weren’t participating, were the same. With the Universe’s reinforcements, there was only minimal shaking in their worlds that caused next to no destruction.
But...
Destruction wasn’t what worried them.
It was the knowledge.
Every single being in the Universe heard Seraphielle’s words, they knew what was happening, they knew two Infinities and their factions were now at war.
And this war...
This might engulf the entire Universe, even the unrelated worlds.
Words began to spread.
"They must participate in the war as well."
"Darkness’s army will be coming here soon, those who refuse to join them will be killed that instant so that Light doesn’t get to them."
"This is all Anomaly’s plan, the Universe cannot resist the Anomaly, this is the end of the Universe."
And with these words, fear grew. Even the world leaders weren’t exceptions, they too were being consumed by their fear, even if they tried to hide it.
These were the worlds that weren’t involved in the battle, as for those who were...
They had it even worse.
Light Worlds had attacked many important Darkness Worlds, many Darkness Worlds had already fallen, some had survived, some less important worlds weren’t attacked at all.
These worlds, craving more violence and destruction, instead of defending their allies, rushed and attacked the Light Worlds instead.
And soon, the fact that the Light Worlds were completely defenseless was revealed. Light had put everything into the attack, so these worlds had almost free rein to attack wherever they wanted.
Yes, worlds in the Darkness Faction were falling, but Light Worlds had started falling as well. With no one defending them, destroying them was only a matter of time.
Every once in a while, however, they encountered worlds that were much more than defended, they had Light Borns defending the place and these Light Borns...
They only had one mission, to eradicate the entire army that came to them.
Yes, Seraphielle had even considered what she was supposed to do with the rogue Darkness Worlds that decided to attack the undefended Light Worlds.
As for the Darkness worlds that moved to defend instead of attacking, their situation wasn’t any better either.

By the time they appeared to help, the enemy had already won, and since the enemy had the advantage in strength and weapons, the Darkness reinforcements were essentially facing a complete army that was prepared and... wasn’t even tired.
All of the Darkness Worlds, except for the Supreme World of Darkness, had a strong disadvantage in this war.
Within just hours since the battle began—
About sixty Darkness Worlds, out of which fifty-two were High Level Worlds, had fallen.
Yes, fifty-two High Level Worlds.
And these weren’t just any random worlds, these were worlds that were considered to be the pillars of the Darkness Faction.

The amount of destruction and loss the Darkness Faction had to deal with after their disappearance was already reaching the amount of damage the Light Faction suffered after the Anomaly attacked them for years.
And this was only the few hours since the battle began.
On the other side, far, far away from all this death and destruction, so far that even the shockwaves of the war didn’t reach here, a being watched it all happen with his distant, golden eyes.
’It really happened.’
That being then heard a voice in his head and he smiled.
"Right? I didn’t think it would actually happen either."
Nux laughed, looking at everything with amusement.
’When Father said he would be able to provoke a reaction, I did not think it would be... this.’
Aeliana muttered, she, along with all the other women, was locked inside Nux’s Universe.
Yes, the moment Nux heard about the war, he prohibited all the women from leaving his Universe. It was too dangerous outside, the chaos and unpredictability were at their peak.
Anything could happen right now, and he needed to prepare as such.
"I didn’t think of it either."
Nux nodded.
He had expected a war to break out at some point, this was the entire reason he was doing all this in the first place, but he still didn’t expect it to happen so soon.
’Lord Azriel was an Infinity too, he knows the extent of their arrogance, he understands that well, using it against them shouldn’t be difficult for him.’
Vyriana commented.
But then—
’It wasn’t just Lord Azriel.
Light’s attack was too well planned for it to all be just a spur-of-the-moment thought, the weapons were distributed, the strategy was clear.
She was already planning on waging a war, even if Lord Azriel hadn’t done anything. Lord Azriel’s words might have pushed that ahead.’
Amaya spoke as well and once again, Nux nodded in agreement.
He could see it as well, Seraphielle had planned it well.
’But to think she was preparing for war and we didn’t even know of it. That is... unnerving.’
Riona seemed concerned.
’She had that leverage. With constant memory scans, it became impossible to keep an eye on Light Worlds and their movements.
It was the same for other factions too, memory scans and the Light lockdown removed any possibility of them being able to get any information regarding the Light Worlds.
Plus Seraphielle made it all look so natural that it was almost impossible to understand what she was planning.
We could go and control one being in one world every single month before he was caught, but that would only make our movements more predictable.
We cannot take that risk.’
Amaya explained and Riona only nodded at those words. She understood that as well, but it still felt... strange.
A being as strong as Seraphielle being able to hide information to such an extent...
Riona wasn’t saying Seraphielle should be stupid, she was a being older than time itself, she was bound to be wise but...
She was also one of the strongest beings in the Universe, a being almost no other being could even dare to challenge, that should come with... some level of carelessness, should it not?
’It doesn’t matter.’
Suddenly, Astaria spoke up.
’What matters is that war has begun.
What we wanted happened.
Now, it’s time for us to move.’
Then she snorted inwardly and corrected herself.
’It’s time for you to move.’
She spoke begrudgingly, talking to Nux. Well, more than a conversation, it was a complaint. She wanted to join in the fun as well.
But Astaria also realized that it wasn’t the right time,
Not now.
She thought inwardly as she looked down and stared at her large, stretched belly. A belly that now had a complete life inside it, a life that could come out any moment now.
Yes.
It was finally happening.
And not just Astaria, every single woman was in their last days and Allura, she was the closest.
New family members could join them at any moment and because it was such a crucial moment, Nux too did not wish to waste even a single moment.
At this moment, he wanted to stay with his wives, honestly, he wouldn’t even have left the Universe if this wasn’t the ideal time to do what he wanted.
But whatever.
In the end, Nux shook his head.
Since he had to be here, he decided to make it quick.
And for that—
For the first time in his entire life,
He was going to use...that.
The moment Nux thought about it, the air around him became heavier, his long black hair began flowing, making him look like a lone King who ruled over the void.
And he—
He tapped into his Dragon Blood.

And not just Astaria, every single woman was in their last days and Allura, she was the closest.
New family members could join them at any moment and because it was such a crucial moment, Nux too did not wish to waste even a single moment.
At this moment, he wanted to stay with his wives, honestly, he wouldn’t even have left the Universe if this wasn’t the ideal time to do what he wanted.
But whatever.
In the end, Nux shook his head.
Since he had to be here, he decided to make it quick.
And for that—
For the first time in his entire life,
He was going to use...that.
The moment Nux thought about it, the air around him became heavier, his long black hair began flowing, making him look like a lone King who ruled over the void.
And he—
He tapped into his Dragon Blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 2295: Dragon—Monster.
paragraphs: In an empty void far, far away from the battle between the two Infinities, Nux hovered alone.

There was no wind, no ground, no sound around him, only the Universal Energy and debris that would turn into another world after hundreds or maybe thousands of years—if the Universe survives that long, that is.
Nux was in his human form and was staring at the battle, well, not staring, he was too far away to see it, he was... feeling it.
He could tell it had already begun.

His long black hair floated around his shoulders. His body was lean and muscular, built like a weapon that didn’t need armor. His shirt hung open, exposing his collarbone and his lean, muscular build, a body that seemed like it was carved out by the finest craftsmen in the Universe.
His face was still the same, still too handsome to be real, a being who could tempt or seduce any being, regardless of their race.
A being who... looked too relaxed for someone who was about to do what Nux planned to do.
Nux tapped into his Dragon Blood, a blood he had been suppressing and strengthening all this while, it wasn’t dramatic, at least not at first.
There were no grand explosions or anything like that.
There were only small changes.
First were his eyes.
The golden glow of his eyes deepened, becoming much brighter than before.

Then, it was his body. His skin darkened, his bones began to stretch, his spine extended, vertebra by vertebra, lengthening into something impossible. His arms split and reshaped, joints rearranging into powerful forelimbs. His fingers fused, turning into talons that looked like curved blades carved from night.
And—
Flap
Giant, batlike wings erupted from his back. They were so ridiculously huge that when they unfolded, it felt like continents were being separated, and this was when the transformation wasn’t done.
Yes, they were still growing, and the pace at which they did hadn’t slowed down, not one bit.
Then, his scales appeared, covering his entire, still expanding body.
And Nux’s scales weren’t the usual red or orange scales Dragons usually had. They were black with a tinge of purple and thin streaks of cosmic silver.
It was as if... the scales were made from the Universe itself.
After all this, Nux’s ’face’ changed as well, if it could even be called a face, that is.
His jaw pushed forward, his teeth grew out in rows, like multiple ridiculously large fangs. Two glossy, sharp horns curved from his skull.
And everything...
Everything kept growing.
His chest became the size of a city.
Then a continent.
Then something that made moons look small.
And when the transformation was finally complete, when he stopped growing—
Nux opened his eyes, two golden balls of intense heat and light that lit up the dark void around him.
Then—
Flap

He spread his wings, this time completely, and when he did, the void itself felt... small. The debris behind him completely disappeared, blocked by the shadow of something too large to belong in any sane universe.
*Picture*
Finally, Nux’s mouth curved slightly and—
In a voice that didn’t travel through air but through existence itself.
"This feels... different."
He spoke.
Within seconds, the small man hovering in space had completely disappeared and was replaced by... an entity that... couldn’t be explained.
It was a Dragon.
Yes, that was very apparent.
But...
No Dragon had ever looked like this.
It wasn’t even close.
First was the sheer size itself.
Its body was... ridiculously large, at least a hundred thousand kilometers, and that was just a number one would think of if they ever had the misfortune to see it.
No one actually dared to measure it.
A more accurate or... sensible description of his size would be that if Nux opened his mouth, it would be large enough to swallow an average low-level world like it was candy.
And that was just the mouth, the rest of his body was much larger.
Nux didn’t look like a living entity with a mind of his own, he looked like... a nightmare. A monster without a mind, an entity of pure destruction, fear and... death.
A cosmic beast, large enough to coil around a world and crush it with pure physical might alone, or outright swallow it whole and not leave anything behind.
And that was exactly what he did.
The Dragon moved.
He wasn’t fast.

His body was too large, if he also had the ability to move as fast as he usually does, considering his current mass, that would change the very flow of gravity around him, making the very Universe collapse.
That wasn’t possible, even for a being of impossibility like Nux.
But of course, being slow didn’t mean Nux didn’t have a way around it, he wasn’t just a Dragon, he was a Dragon with absolute mastery over the Power of Space.
He could always... teleport.
Of course, using space to cover an entity so ridiculously huge would take an absurd amount of energy but...

This was the man who had devoured thousands of worlds at this point, quite a few of which were High Level Worlds, worlds that were no different than an endless supply of energy. A supply Nux knew how to have complete access to.
If it was just energy, there weren’t many beings in the Universe who could actually compete with him.
Even the Infinities were no exception.
Of course, nothing could be said for sure since no one knew how strong an Infinity actually was, but Nux also knew he had an endless supply.
He had almost fifty High Level Worlds’ worth of energy and this wasn’t even considering the rest of the worlds he had.
He highly doubted an Infinity had that amount of power.
Sure, the quality of their energy might be higher, far higher than his in fact, even an Eternal’s quality of energy was better than his, but when it came to quantity, Nux was quite confident.
So teleporting his ridiculously large body?
Nux had no worries.
He teleported himself to a different location and didn’t even feel a thing.
At least...
He didn’t.
As for the place he teleported to, well...
That was different.
Nux had teleported to a world-dense space, a space where quite a few worlds were present, about fifty of them.

And every single one of these worlds felt the change in the Universe near them, the leaders of these worlds instantly realized that ’something’ had happened around them and considering that Light and Darkness were at war—
They knew it wasn’t good news.

These worlds reacted quite quickly, contacting the factions they belonged to was useless, at least that was the case for Darkness and Light, the two factions, because of the war, were in complete chaos.
They were overwhelmed with war reports like victories, defeats, losses, gains, deaths, captures, information regarding the enemy or calls for reinforcements from worlds that were falling apart.
At a time like this, sending a message like ’something was happening around them’ was... outright foolish.
The message would only be buried under the countless more ’actually important’ messages that were sent and it was only natural.
The leaders knew they couldn’t do it, they needed a more... proper report.
And to make a proper report, they needed to understand what was happening, so it happened—
The leaders sent their men to look. About thirty of the fifty worlds sent their men out and what these men saw made them widen their eyes in absolute horror.
A ridiculously large... monster flying in the Void and... swallowing an entire world in its mouth.
They didn’t even know how they were supposed to report this nightmare but—
"REPORT!! REPORT!!!"
That was what they had to do.
So they did.
"A MONSTER! THERE IS A MONSTER!"

[Monster? A monster was responsible for that sudden shaking and darkness? What monster? What does it look like? Don’t bother answering, just tell me. Do you need reinforcements, or will you be able to take care of it on your own?]
The answers came, of course, each world leader said different things, but the meaning behind them was the same nonetheless and so were the reactions of the scouts.
"NO! YOU DO NOT UNDERSTAND!!! IT’S A MONSTER!!! A MONSTER!!!"
They screamed, looking at the scene in front of them in horror.
"IT HAS SWALLOWED SEVEN WORLDS ALREADY!!!"
[Swallow? Do you mean it’s attacking seven worlds at the same time?]
The leaders questioned in confusion. Just what were these people talking about? Had they lost their minds?
Yes, the leaders couldn’t comprehend the concept of literal worlds being ’swallowed’ whole.
And that only made the scouts more desperate.
"NO!! I KNOW THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN ATTACKING AND SWALLOWING DAMMIT!! IT SWALLOWED SE—ELEVEN WORLDS NOW!!
THEY ARE GONE!!
THEY NO LONGER EXIST AND IT’S STILL MOVING!!"
The scouts reported, some of them actually tried to attack, using their strongest attacks with the strongest available weapons but the attacks didn’t even put a dent in the monstrous entity.
"Fuck this! I am not dying!!!"
Suddenly, one of the scouts from a certain world, his face full of fright, screamed loudly, threw his communication artifact at the monstrous entity, then...
He ran away, no longer wanting to stick around.
And after him...
The rest followed.
No one wanted to die.
At least not inside this monster’s stomach.

chapters.title: Chapter 2296: Second Anomaly.
paragraphs: "Fuck this! I am not dying!!!"
One of the many scouts threw his communication artifact at the monster in front of him with a frightened look on his face and ran away.
The rest of the scouts watched him.
[Eleven worlds disappeared!? What in the hell are you talking about!? Explain clearly!]
The leaders of the remaining worlds continued to ask the same question and the scouts could see it.
It was hopeless.
In just this little moment, five more worlds had disappeared, the monster had swallowed them and the scouts that were part of the disappeared worlds could no longer feel their worlds.
And then—
As if to make everything clearer—
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
The Universe’s Will reacted again.
A reaction every being in the Universe was now... used to.
It was... the Universe’s anger.
Anger that it only showed when the Anomaly appeared.
The moment the scouts realized that, they looked at the monster in front of them with even stronger fright.
This... was the Anomaly...?

They wondered in their heads. All of them had seen the recording, they had seen how the Anomaly looked and whatever he was, if there was one thing most... females in the Universe could agree on, it was that...
He was pleasing to the eyes.
His smile, his confidence, his... presence, everything they saw in the recording, even as he killed people, he was... charming.
And this monster—
It was far from charming.
It was... nightmarish.
This couldn’t be the Anomaly, there was no way.
Another question appeared in their heads.
If this was not the Anomaly then... who was it...?
Then they thought about what the Anomaly actually was. A being from another Universe. So if this being wasn’t the Anomaly but the Universe was reacting to it like it was, then...
Then that would mean he was... the second Anomaly.
Another being from some other Universe.
The Anomaly’s ally?
Maybe.
But if that possibility was indeed true...
Then that would mean there were now two Anomalies and... the new one didn’t seem any weaker either. No, in fact, it looked far stronger and more terrifying.
Not to mention the two Infinities themselves had started fighting each other and many lives were being taken.
In a situation as chaotic as this, the presence of a second Anomaly was...
The scouts paled in fear.
[Hey! Why is the Universe reacting that way? Is it because of the monster!? Or has the Anomaly struck again!? But there are still three days before he attacks again.
HEY! ANSWER ME! ANSWER OR DO NOT EXPECT TO RETURN ALIVE!!]
Loud voices continued to come from their communication artifacts, voices from the world leaders, well, from those that were... still alive.
But...
The scouts could see it.
It was hopeless.
The leaders, even if they realized what was happening, it wouldn’t matter.
The enemy was... far too strong for their world leaders to do anything about it, the only thing they could do was request aid from the Supreme Worlds.
But honestly—

The Universe had already reacted, the Supreme Worlds must have sensed it as well, since they hadn’t sent someone here to investigate until now, the scouts highly doubted the leaders’ reports and calls for aid would do anything.
And even if they did send anything, if this being was anywhere close to the real Anomaly in terms of strength, which it very clearly looked like it was—
Even the Supreme Worlds’ reinforcements would be useless.
So—
The best course of action here, after considering every little thing, was to—
Run.
And that’s what the remaining scouts did.
They ran.
[Hey! HEY! ANSWER ME! I SWEAR TO GO—]

And the world leaders and their worlds were left behind to be devoured, and until the very end, they didn’t even know what hit them. Not that it was anything different from any of the Anomaly’s other victims.
Most of them were devoured before even understanding what was happening to them.

On the other side, near the void that had now become a battlefield between two Infinities, the void that the Universe itself had isolated to prevent any further colossal-level damage, a void that every single life form had either abandoned or had been caught in the battle and perished without remains—
Two beings hovered in the air, the shockwaves from the explosions, shockwaves that would kill almost every single being in the Universe, passed their bodies and only made their clothes and hair move.
Like they were hit by a strong wind.
"Did you sense that?"
One of them questioned as he turned toward the other.
The two Infinities were watching the battle with great interest, the battle was a good thing for them, so watching it was indeed fun, but while they were enjoying the show, something happened.
The Universe shook, not because of the battle, but because of a familiar reason.
"He made another move. That was different from his usual pattern."
Equarios commented with a curious smile, even then, his eyes did not move from the two Supremes.
"This was not the Anomaly."
Orravyn shook his head with a smile.
"Hmm?"
Equarios frowned and finally turned toward the being standing next to him. Orravyn looked at him and nodded with a meaningful look on his face.
Equarios’s frown deepened, then, without wasting time, he closed his eyes, connected with the Universe’s Will and his vision was taken to the place where it was happening.
And the moment he saw that giant monstrosity, he raised an eyebrow.
Orravyn smiled at that reaction, he had the same reaction when he first watched, of course, he hid it well, so well that Equarios didn’t even realize what he was doing.
"What is it?"
Equarios questioned as he narrowed his eyes, but Orravyn just shook his head—
"How am I supposed to know? I have never seen that creature in my life."
"Then shouldn’t we check it out?"
Equarios asked and Orravyn looked at him with a strange look on his face.
"You mean we personally?"
"If it’s anyone else and that being is as strong as or stronger than the Anomaly, it won’t matter. They will just be devoured. And the way it is swallowing those worlds, it doesn’t look weak."
Equarios explained and Orravyn just stared at his ’friend’ and seemed even more surprised, genuinely surprised.
"You truly do wish to check it out yourself. I have never seen you so keenly interested in matters that didn’t involve balance."
"It does involve balance, one of the worlds that is being devoured is part of the Balance Faction."
Equarios answered.
Orravyn then shrugged—
"Alright then, if you do go in, do let me spend some time with the body when you are done, of course."
"You won’t be coming?"

Equarios frowned. A being like Orravyn, someone who craved knowledge, had the opportunity to capture a being from another Universe, a Universe he didn’t understand anything about and that was an endless pile of knowledge to him, something he wouldn’t let go of no matter what.
It meant something was different.
"What are you thinking?"
Equarios asked directly.
"Hmm? What do you mean?"
Orravyn feigned ignorance but Equarios—
"Forget it."
He placed his hand behind his back, it was clear that he wasn’t going either. Orravyn looked at him, then he just smiled and didn’t say anything.
Did he wish to live?
He did but...
It just wasn’t the right time.
First, that monstrosity was probably one of the creatures from the Universe the Anomaly was from, it was tempting to capture and study it.
But...
Orravyn couldn’t leave.
He did not know what the monster was, but it seemed like a mere beast. A beast with no mind but a ridiculous amount of power.
And if it was indeed a beast, then it must have a power to control it, a King, per se.
Then how could he, an Infinity, leave to deal with the enemy’s pet.
That would be humiliating and ruin his good name.
And even if he did ignore those consequences, since, as an Infinity, especially the one who did not rely on Authority like the other three did—
People’s opinions rarely mattered to him.
What did matter, however, were the other Infinities, especially those who were still going at each other with a considerable amount of power.

At a time like this, anything, absolutely anything could happen. One trigger, just one trigger was more than enough for the two Infinities underneath to stop the battle and attack someone else instead.
If he left his world unprotected—
He would lose... an absurd number of artifacts and relics he had used to protect it in case these two decided to target him for some reason.
And yes, he wasn’t just being paranoid, this could happen.
So chasing after a beast from another Universe, as interesting as it sounded, wasn’t more interesting than the battlefield in front of them.

Plus, somewhere in their hearts, this seemed connected to the Anomaly, this beast might very well be his pet and if the Anomaly figured out that his dog was taken away, he might... start targeting them instead of Light.
Yes, somewhere inside them, they feared the Anomaly because of his vile, underhanded tactics.
So they wanted to stay clear, at least while it was possible.
As for the beast...
"Let’s see how long it continues."
Orravyn smiled.
Now, he was watching two interesting things at the same time.

Most of them were devoured before even understanding what was happening to them.

On the other side, near the void that had now become a battlefield between two Infinities, the void that the Universe itself had isolated to prevent any further colossal-level damage, a void that every single life form had either abandoned or had been caught in the battle and perished without remains—
Two beings hovered in the air, the shockwaves from the explosions, shockwaves that would kill almost every single being in the Universe, passed their bodies and only made their clothes and hair move.
Like they were hit by a strong wind.
"Did you sense that?"
One of them questioned as he turned toward the other.
The two Infinities were watching the battle with great interest, the battle was a good thing for them, so watching it was indeed fun, but while they were enjoying the show, something happened.
The Universe shook, not because of the battle, but because of a familiar reason.
"He made another move.
That was different from his usual pattern."
Equarios commented with a curious smile, even then, his eyes did not move from the two Supremes.
"This was not the Anomaly."
Orravyn shook his head with a smile.
"Hmm?"
Equarios frowned and finally turned toward the being standing next to him.
Orravyn looked at him and nodded with a meaningful look on his face.
Equarios’s frown deepened, then, without wasting time, he closed his eyes, connected with the Universe’s Will and his vision was taken to the place where it was happening.
And the moment he saw that giant monstrosity, he raised an eyebrow.
Orravyn smiled at that reaction, he had the same reaction when he first watched, of course, he hid it well, so well that Equarios didn’t even realize what he was doing.
"What is it?"
Equarios questioned as he narrowed his eyes, but Orravyn just shook his head—
"How am I supposed to know?
I have never seen that creature in my life."
"Then shouldn’t we check it out?"
Equarios asked and Orravyn looked at him with a strange look on his face.
"You mean we personally?"
"If it’s anyone else and that being is as strong as or stronger than the Anomaly, it won’t matter.
They will just be devoured.
And the way it is swallowing those worlds, it doesn’t look weak."
Equarios explained and Orravyn just stared at his ’friend’ and seemed even more surprised, genuinely surprised.
"You truly do wish to check it out yourself.
I have never seen you so keenly interested in matters that didn’t involve balance."
"It does involve balance, one of the worlds that is being devoured is part of the Balance Faction."
Equarios answered.
Orravyn then shrugged—
"Alright then, if you do go in, do let me spend some time with the body when you are done, of course."
"You won’t be coming?"
Equarios frowned.

A being like Orravyn, someone who craved knowledge, had the opportunity to capture a being from another Universe, a Universe he didn’t understand anything about and that was an endless pile of knowledge to him, something he wouldn’t let go of no matter what.
It meant something was different.
"What are you thinking?"
Equarios asked directly.
"Hmm?
What do you mean?"
Orravyn feigned ignorance but Equarios—
"Forget it."
He placed his hand behind his back, it was clear that he wasn’t going either.
Orravyn looked at him, then he just smiled and didn’t say anything.
Did he wish to live?
He did but...
It just wasn’t the right time.
First, that monstrosity was probably one of the creatures from the Universe the Anomaly was from, it was tempting to capture and study it.
But...
Orravyn couldn’t leave.
He did not know what the monster was, but it seemed like a mere beast.
A beast with no mind but a ridiculous amount of power.
And if it was indeed a beast, then it must have a power to control it, a King, per se.
Then how could he, an Infinity, leave to deal with the enemy’s pet.
That would be humiliating and ruin his good name.
And even if he did ignore those consequences, since, as an Infinity, especially the one who did not rely on Authority like the other three did—
People’s opinions rarely mattered to him.
What did matter, however, were the other Infinities, especially those who were still going at each other with a considerable amount of power.
At a time like this, anything, absolutely anything could happen.
One trigger, just one trigger was more than enough for the two Infinities underneath to stop the battle and attack someone else instead.
If he left his world unprotected—
He would lose... an absurd number of artifacts and relics he had used to protect it in case these two decided to target him for some reason.
And yes, he wasn’t just being paranoid, this could happen.
So chasing after a beast from another Universe, as interesting as it sounded, wasn’t more interesting than the battlefield in front of them.

Plus, somewhere in their hearts, this seemed connected to the Anomaly, this beast might very well be his pet and if the Anomaly figured out that his dog was taken away, he might... start targeting them instead of Light.
Yes, somewhere inside them, they feared the Anomaly because of his vile, underhanded tactics.
So they wanted to stay clear, at least while it was possible.
As for the beast...
"Let’s see how long it continues."
Orravyn smiled.
Now, he was watching two interesting things at the same time.

chapters.title: Chapter 2297: Then why didn’t you leave? I never stopped you.
paragraphs: Five seconds.
That was all it took for more than fifty worlds to disappear.
There was no fight, no resistance, no world leaders coming out to face what was happening, and it wasn’t like they didn’t try or that they didn’t get the chance to.
After the scouts ran away and almost no information could be found, a few world leaders left their worlds to see for themselves and they—
They saw it.
The entity of destruction that was swallowing literal worlds as if they were rice balls.

They tried to stop it, they activated their domains, they launched their strongest attacks, they worked together, even the world leaders who could be called lifelong enemies let go of their enmity when it came to survival and attacked together.
But it didn’t matter.
Let alone stop it, their attacks didn’t even slow down that monstrosity, it continued to devour the remaining worlds at the same speed that it was doing before the leaders came to stop him.
As for the leaders’ attacks, that was like a few flies throwing small sticks at a giant, it didn’t even tickle or cause any sort of disturbance.
Their domains that allowed them to be absolute, domains that made most of their followers bow their heads, the moment they touched the monstrosity’s body, they... collapsed.
No world leader knew or understood what happened.
But one second was all it took for them to realize that this wasn’t a battle they could win and they—
Just like the scouts, they too ran away. Their faces showed terror so pure that it was almost pitiful.
They didn’t wish to be devoured, not by that monstrosity but their minds could already imagine the horrifying sight of that monstrosity chasing them.
They tried to think of a way, a way to survive.
Would numbers help?
What if they called their allies and waited for them with an army, an army prepared to stop this monstrosity?
But...
An army?
This monster devoured a world right in front of them, what could numbers possibly do to it?
That idea was dropped faster than it came.
Calling more allies? That wouldn’t work either. The leaders could see it, even thousands, ten thousand, or millions of them couldn’t stop this thing.
They needed someone stronger.
Someone... far, far stronger than them.
Supreme Worlds.
That was their only option.
But...
He had already sent a call for aid but he hadn’t received an answer. The Supreme Worlds were clearly busy with war, they wouldn’t do anything.
Unless...
They were forced to.
Suddenly, the leaders’ expressions changed.
How could they force the Supreme Worlds?
They thought inwardly and very quickly, the answer was clear. They needed to take this monster to them.
If it continued to chase them and they got close to the Supreme Worlds, then they would have no choice but to act, else the Universe would call them cowards.
Yes.
That was it.
That was the only way.

Now the only thing they needed to worry about was being fast enough to take this monstrosity with them. They gathered all the artifacts that could help them with this in their minds, a complete plan began to form but then suddenly—
"H-Hey!"
One of the world leaders called out.
The others turned toward him, wanting to know what had happened.
He had suddenly stopped and was staring back toward the monster with a terrified expression on his face. That made the other world leaders turn around as well, of course, none of them stopped.
The one who stopped would be devoured, that was very clear, they just needed a quick look.
But...
The moment they turned and saw what was happening, they too paused, like the first world leader.
"W-What is that...?"
One of them asked.
"A-A... portal?"
Another guessed.

The monster had already devoured all the worlds in this area, the nearest world around was about a few hundred thousand kilometres away, so while it was very possible for it to go for those worlds, it was more likely for it to chase the survivors.
Or at least—
That’s what the world leaders thought in their minds but as they were staring at the monster they noticed...
A pitch black... hole appear in front of him, a hole that was large enough to fit even this monstrosity.
A hole that the monster was moving towards.
For a moment, they didn’t know what this ’hole’ was, they just knew that it was huge and the energy that came from it was... strange.
Something they couldn’t recognize.
Something... foreign.
And very quickly, their doubts disappeared as well because the monster moved toward the hole and... it was swallowed whole.
Yes.
The monster disappeared.
Or more accurately, it went away.
It returned to wherever it came from.
"Does it mean... we survived?"
Suddenly, one of the world leaders commented, there was still a lost look on his face, as if he couldn’t believe that he actually survived this calamity.
The rest of the world leaders were the same, seeing the empty void in front of them, the empty void where the worlds they once ruled existed, they felt... uncomfortable.
The silence around them was frightening.
Just now, their minds were coming up with different plans to survive the enemy’s attack and now...
They stood in silence.
They stood... safe.
Not because they won or that their plan worked.
But because the ’enemy’ decided to leave, or more accurately, the enemy never once cared about them.
They were just... there.
Their life or death didn’t matter to that monstrosity that did all this.
And when they realized it, they felt... small, they felt... insignificant.

A feeling they weren’t used to, especially since they ruled over billions of lives and every single word that came from their mouth, even the ones they said completely out of the blue, were taken absolutely seriously.
Not that any of it mattered right now, and the world leaders knew that.
It was over.
Their worlds no longer existed, even their connection to their World’s Will, that was always with them, had disappeared.
And now...
They didn’t know what they were supposed to do.
One thing they did notice, however, was the residual energy of that... portal.
"A portal to another Universe."
One of the world leaders muttered after a few seconds of complete, dead silence.
"Another Universe..."
The rest of the world leaders were the same. They didn’t forget it, that portal, that darkness that was made as if they weren’t allowed to look inside, that foreign energy that felt different.
All of it was proof.
Another Universe did exist.
Sure, they had heard about its existence from the Infinities, they had heard that the Anomaly was from another Universe.
But hearing and seeing were two entirely different things.
And it wasn’t just them—
The two beings that were watching it all play out far, far away were the same.
"Was that...?"
Equarios looked at Orravyn, he didn’t even have to complete his question, he knew Orravyn would understand, and Orravyn did.
"Looks like it."
The Infinity of Eternity nodded.
"So it really does exist. Another Universe.
And to think there is one Universe that has found a way to invade another Universe."
Equarios muttered.
"Doesn’t it excite you?"
Orravyn smiled.
And at that question, Equarios looked in the direction where the portal was formed, then beneath him where Light and Darkness were still going at each other and he—
"No."
He shook his head.
This did not excite him.
Not one bit.
Because it... scared him.
If a Universe had indeed found a way to invade theirs, then they needed to be at their strongest to deal with it.
But...
Let alone their strongest, they were probably at their weakest.
The Fifth Infinity is not in sync with the others, they know absolutely nothing about him.
Light was already weakened by the enemy.
Now Light and Darkness are at war and the longer the war continues, the weaker both sides will be.
This...
This was honestly the perfect opportunity for the enemy to invade them and... the chances of them coming out victorious were... low.
"You think a lot."
Orravyn commented with a light smile.
"This matter shouldn’t be taken lightly."
Equarios commented.
He was still calmer at first, but seeing the portal to another Universe himself changed everything.
"The enemy Universe is getting bolder.
It was only the Anomaly before.
But now they have started sending more destructive creatures.
This cannot go on any longer.
We need to take action."
"And what should we do?"
Orravyn asked.
"Information.
We need more information.
We need to capture these foreign entities and learn about their Universe."
Equarios answered.
"I assure you, Equarios."
Orravyn spoke.

"You won’t find anything. They sent that mindless creature for a reason. We capture it, then try to find something, at best, we would find nothing, at worst, they must have planted false information to fool us."
"Then we need to invade their Universe and learn about it."
Equarios gave a more desperate solution.
But...
The problem was still the same.
"Then why didn’t you leave? I never stopped you."
