chapters.title: Chapter 2298: You are shaking.
paragraphs: "Then why didn’t you leave? I never stopped you."
Orravyn asked and Equarios...
The Infinity of Balance turned silent.
This was the problem, the biggest issue with the Infinities.
These were the beings who had been scheming against each other for trillions of years, their rivalry was the greatest rivalry in the history of the Universe.
They were, in no way, allies, neither were they rivals.
They were enemies who were out for each other’s lives. Every single one of them would pounce on the offer if it meant one of the other Infinities would die.

These were beings who were always planning to kill each other, no, killing was only one of the final goals, these beings would pounce even if it meant they would gain a slightly stronger advantage over the others.
In a situation as... tense as theirs, it was impossible for any one of them to do something that would benefit every single one of them.
Sure, that particular action might give them the same benefit as well, but even then, they put in the effort, why should others get to enjoy the result?
Was it petty?
Of course. Childish even.
But that was just how the Infinities were, beings who got every single thing they desired, beings who ruled over the entire Universe—
Their egos were inflated to a ridiculous level.
And because of that—
Going into an unknown Universe to get information regarding the enemy, a mission that could very well endanger their lives.
None of the Infinities would agree to it.
None of them would go, not unless they ensured that every single one of them, the Fifth Infinity included, would go.
And even then, they would constantly suspect each other of betraying the others and pulling a trick.
It was... complicated or maybe... it was oddly simple.
And Nux was using that to his advantage.
At this point, he had devoured thousands of worlds, he had devoured worlds that were present since the beginning of time, worlds that had... witnessed it all.
Worlds that... were present ever since the Infinities were.
And he had watched those worlds’ histories. Every single thing that happened, sure, he only saw those particular worlds’ perspectives, he only saw what was happening in those worlds—
And that was enough.

More than enough actually, he had seen the Infinities in action, he had seen how petty, how... small these beings were and the more worlds he devoured, the more ’information’ he got, the more he ’reinforced’ his mind, his plan only became even stronger.
To use the Infinities’ ego, to use their ’enmity’ against each other.
And it worked.
He appeared right in front of them.
He gave them a direct chance to attack him, to capture him, to end this battle—
But they did not move, not because they were scared of each other, but because they were wary of each other.
The battle between Light and Darkness put them in a safe situation, but that same thing also made them more paranoid.
How?
The first were Light and Darkness, Seraphielle and Ul’Thakar, they were fighting and they knew this fight would weaken them in the future and give the advantage to Eternity and Balance.
At this point in time, why would they go and confront an unknown entity when the other two were very capable of doing so?
As for the other two in question, well, both Equarios and Orravyn already had the advantage. It was only a matter of time before they became the stronger two out of the four Infinities now.
They were already in a better position, then why risk it?
Why look down?
Why not... look up?
They were the stronger two out of the four, what if they now somehow weakened the second? Then they would be the strongest.
Wouldn’t it be better if the other one confronted the enemy, entered the unknown Universe and... disappeared?
How... convenient would that be?
It was tempting and both Orravyn and Equarios hoped for the same thing, and because of that, they both refused to move.
The worst part?
They both knew this thinking was paralyzing them, that the enemy was using this against them—
But there was nothing they could do.
No matter what, they couldn’t bring themselves to trust each other, that was what trillions and trillions of years of enmity had instilled into them.
And Nux—
Who watched it all happen from far away, seeing it all going exactly as he planned—
He smiled and—
He closed the portal to his Universe.
He was safe again.
And he had returned to his Universe, this time, after devouring about sixty-five worlds at the same time.
That was more than enough, that would... last a good while and give him time to spend with his family in this... crucial time.
’Nux, it’s happening.’
And just as he returned to his Universe, he heard Shadow’s voice.
A message that he was already expecting to hear but when he heard it, it still made him... tense.
For a moment, everything around him turned silent.
Then, after a good few seconds, he let out a huge breath, the very void around him felt like it was exhaling with him, letting out its tension.

The black-purple scales then began to fold inward, his giant wings shrank, horns melted into shadow, talons softened into fingers, and that enormous, world-devouring throat quieted until it was only... a man’s chest that was rising and falling like it normally does.

Yes, he returned to his human form, his long black hair drifted around his shoulders. His lean, muscular body glowed faintly, the light purple-black marks left were like proof of what he had become just a few moments ago.
Then his golden eyes moved in a particular direction and he stepped forward. The very space around him folded and...
He disappeared.
And reappeared in another room, a room where all his wives were present, waiting for him, and in the center of that room—
There was Allura.
She was lying on a wide bed.
Her face was pale, it wasn’t painful, it shouldn’t be, not at the level she was at. Her body was just... strained.
It was holding something that the Universe itself was still learning to support, it wasn’t easy.
Her long white hair clung to her temples and her purple eyes that usually shone with a playful, seductive and amused light were now... glossy.
As if she was holding back her tears.
Nux quickly rushed toward her, knelt next to the bed and held her hands, his heart beating at a scary pace. Allura laughed when she saw that—
"You are here."
She muttered in an exhausted voice.

The rest of the women watched it all in silence, every single one of them was carrying life within them, none of them were as close as Allura, but in their minds, they had already imagined themselves in her place and that thought alone made them go through different emotions.
For now, however, the women were only focused on Allura, her health and the health of the new member of their family who would... appear any moment now.
Shadow focused on the new life that had pretty much already formed, other than Nux and Allura, who could directly feel it inside her, she was the only one who could sense him.
And after a few long seconds—
"It’s time."
Shadow spoke and those words made the entire room go... even more silent.
Especially Nux, he tightened his hold on Allura’s hand and from that firm hold, Allura could sense how... nervous this man was.
"This look does not suit you one bit."
She commented with a light smile.
Nux laughed nervously.
"Look at you, the devourer of worlds, the enemy of the Universe, the one who challenged the Infinities, the nightmare of Light, the fearsome Anomaly,
Holding his wife’s hand, all nervous and tense because his wife’s giving birth.
What would the people in the Universe say if they see you like this."
Allura commented, her voice got weaker the longer she spoke, there was a dry smile on her face.

Again, she wasn’t in pain, but the strain on her body was now at its strongest, all this while she had been supporting her child’s existence on her own, but now, now the Universe was identifying the child’s existence and was trying to make a connection—
Which was being interrupted by Allura’s own connection with the Universe, and that was the cause of the strain.
Nux needed to fix that, Nux needed to bring the child out of Allura’s body and he was prepared to do that but then—
"Nux."
Felberta suddenly called out.
Nux looked at her and—
"You are shaking."
She spoke.
"I am not."
Nux denied it quickly, but the moment he looked down, the moment he saw his hands and his legs, he froze.
"I am... shaking."
He muttered in complete disbelief.
How long had it been since he last... trembled?
Was it when he saw Eisheth for the first time? Or was it when he saw Vyriana? Maybe it was Azriel?
He didn’t remember.
But...
To think he—
The same being who just now played with the strongest beings in the Universe and drove one to madness—
Was now shaking in front of his wife.
It was... quite strange to see.

sentences.text: "Then why didn’t you leave?
I never stopped you."
Orravyn asked and Equarios...
The Infinity of Balance turned silent.
This was the problem, the biggest issue with the Infinities.
These were the beings who had been scheming against each other for trillions of years, their rivalry was the greatest rivalry in the history of the Universe.
They were, in no way, allies, neither were they rivals.
They were enemies who were out for each other’s lives.
Every single one of them would pounce on the offer if it meant one of the other Infinities would die.

These were beings who were always planning to kill each other, no, killing was only one of the final goals, these beings would pounce even if it meant they would gain a slightly stronger advantage over the others.
In a situation as... tense as theirs, it was impossible for any one of them to do something that would benefit every single one of them.
Sure, that particular action might give them the same benefit as well, but even then, they put in the effort, why should others get to enjoy the result?
Was it petty?
Of course.
Childish even.
But that was just how the Infinities were, beings who got every single thing they desired, beings who ruled over the entire Universe—
Their egos were inflated to a ridiculous level.
And because of that—
Going into an unknown Universe to get information regarding the enemy, a mission that could very well endanger their lives.
None of the Infinities would agree to it.
None of them would go, not unless they ensured that every single one of them, the Fifth Infinity included, would go.
And even then, they would constantly suspect each other of betraying the others and pulling a trick.
It was... complicated or maybe... it was oddly simple.
And Nux was using that to his advantage.
At this point, he had devoured thousands of worlds, he had devoured worlds that were present since the beginning of time, worlds that had... witnessed it all.
Worlds that... were present ever since the Infinities were.
And he had watched those worlds’ histories.
Every single thing that happened, sure, he only saw those particular worlds’ perspectives, he only saw what was happening in those worlds—
And that was enough.

More than enough actually, he had seen the Infinities in action, he had seen how petty, how... small these beings were and the more worlds he devoured, the more ’information’ he got, the more he ’reinforced’ his mind, his plan only became even stronger.
To use the Infinities’ ego, to use their ’enmity’ against each other.
And it worked.
He appeared right in front of them.
He gave them a direct chance to attack him, to capture him, to end this battle—
But they did not move, not because they were scared of each other, but because they were wary of each other.
The battle between Light and Darkness put them in a safe situation, but that same thing also made them more paranoid.
How?
The first were Light and Darkness, Seraphielle and Ul’Thakar, they were fighting and they knew this fight would weaken them in the future and give the advantage to Eternity and Balance.
At this point in time, why would they go and confront an unknown entity when the other two were very capable of doing so?
As for the other two in question, well, both Equarios and Orravyn already had the advantage.
It was only a matter of time before they became the stronger two out of the four Infinities now.
They were already in a better position, then why risk it?
Why look down?
Why not... look up?
They were the stronger two out of the four, what if they now somehow weakened the second?
Then they would be the strongest.
Wouldn’t it be better if the other one confronted the enemy, entered the unknown Universe and... disappeared?
How... convenient would that be?
It was tempting and both Orravyn and Equarios hoped for the same thing, and because of that, they both refused to move.
The worst part?
They both knew this thinking was paralyzing them, that the enemy was using this against them—
But there was nothing they could do.
No matter what, they couldn’t bring themselves to trust each other, that was what trillions and trillions of years of enmity had instilled into them.
And Nux—
Who watched it all happen from far away, seeing it all going exactly as he planned—
He smiled and—
He closed the portal to his Universe.
He was safe again.
And he had returned to his Universe, this time, after devouring about sixty-five worlds at the same time.
That was more than enough, that would... last a good while and give him time to spend with his family in this... crucial time.
’Nux, it’s happening.’
And just as he returned to his Universe, he heard Shadow’s voice.
A message that he was already expecting to hear but when he heard it, it still made him... tense.
For a moment, everything around him turned silent.
Then, after a good few seconds, he let out a huge breath, the very void around him felt like it was exhaling with him, letting out its tension.

The black-purple scales then began to fold inward, his giant wings shrank, horns melted into shadow, talons softened into fingers, and that enormous, world-devouring throat quieted until it was only... a man’s chest that was rising and falling like it normally does.
Yes, he returned to his human form, his long black hair drifted around his shoulders.
His lean, muscular body glowed faintly, the light purple-black marks left were like proof of what he had become just a few moments ago.
Then his golden eyes moved in a particular direction and he stepped forward.
The very space around him folded and...
He disappeared.
And reappeared in another room, a room where all his wives were present, waiting for him, and in the center of that room—
There was Allura.
She was lying on a wide bed.
Her face was pale, it wasn’t painful, it shouldn’t be, not at the level she was at.
Her body was just... strained.
It was holding something that the Universe itself was still learning to support, it wasn’t easy.
Her long white hair clung to her temples and her purple eyes that usually shone with a playful, seductive and amused light were now... glossy.
As if she was holding back her tears.
Nux quickly rushed toward her, knelt next to the bed and held her hands, his heart beating at a scary pace.
Allura laughed when she saw that—
"You are here."
She muttered in an exhausted voice.

The rest of the women watched it all in silence, every single one of them was carrying life within them, none of them were as close as Allura, but in their minds, they had already imagined themselves in her place and that thought alone made them go through different emotions.
For now, however, the women were only focused on Allura, her health and the health of the new member of their family who would... appear any moment now.
Shadow focused on the new life that had pretty much already formed, other than Nux and Allura, who could directly feel it inside her, she was the only one who could sense him.
And after a few long seconds—
"It’s time."
Shadow spoke and those words made the entire room go... even more silent.
Especially Nux, he tightened his hold on Allura’s hand and from that firm hold, Allura could sense how... nervous this man was.
"This look does not suit you one bit."
She commented with a light smile.
Nux laughed nervously.
"Look at you, the devourer of worlds, the enemy of the Universe, the one who challenged the Infinities, the nightmare of Light, the fearsome Anomaly,
Holding his wife’s hand, all nervous and tense because his wife’s giving birth.
What would the people in the Universe say if they see you like this."
Allura commented, her voice got weaker the longer she spoke, there was a dry smile on her face.

Again, she wasn’t in pain, but the strain on her body was now at its strongest, all this while she had been supporting her child’s existence on her own, but now, now the Universe was identifying the child’s existence and was trying to make a connection—
Which was being interrupted by Allura’s own connection with the Universe, and that was the cause of the strain.
Nux needed to fix that, Nux needed to bring the child out of Allura’s body and he was prepared to do that but then—
"Nux."
Felberta suddenly called out.
Nux looked at her and—
"You are shaking."
She spoke.
"I am not."
Nux denied it quickly, but the moment he looked down, the moment he saw his hands and his legs, he froze.
"I am... shaking."
He muttered in complete disbelief.
How long had it been since he last... trembled?
Was it when he saw Eisheth for the first time?
Or was it when he saw Vyriana?
Maybe it was Azriel?
He didn’t remember.
But...
To think he—
The same being who just now played with the strongest beings in the Universe and drove one to madness—
Was now shaking in front of his wife.
It was... quite strange to see.

chapters.title: Chapter 2299: The First Child.
paragraphs: "Nux."
Shadow suddenly placed a hand on Nux’s shoulder and nodded with a meaningful look on her face.
"Let me do it."
She spoke.
Nux glanced at her and frowned.
This was important, probably the most important thing in his mind, one step wrong and he would... lose everything.
He couldn’t hurt either the child or his Allura.
This was the reason he decided he would be the one to do it but...
"This is delicate, you know that as well."
Shadow spoke directly, looking into Nux’s eyes.
"You should not be the one doing it, you are too nervous."
"I can kill my emotions and stabilize myself."
Nux countered.
He could do that, at the level he had reached, the amount of bloodlines he had devoured, he had complete control over emotions, be it someone else’s or his own.
But—
"You know you cannot do that."
Shadow answered directly and Nux turned silent. Felberta nodded as well.
"We can’t have you be an emotionless puppet, not right now."
Nux turned towards her, then the rest of the women spoke up as well.
"Exactly, I don’t want you to stand without emotions with my child in your hands. I want to see your reaction, your honest, real reaction."
Eisheth spoke and the rest of the women around nodded, all giving their inputs.
"Exactly."
"Yes, who do you think we are doing this for?"
"Don’t you dare try that."
"Mhm."
Nux looked at the women around him with a deadpan look on his face and—
"You do realize I can return to normal the moment I am done wit—"
"No."
But before he could even say anything, Allura shook her head as she tightened her hold around Nux’s hand.
"Emotions are complicated, don’t think we do not understand that."
The Succubus, lying on the bed with a pale face, spoke as she looked right at Nux and this time, Nux couldn’t say anything in defense.
After all, he was the one who explained this to Allura himself.
While having complete control over one’s emotions had quite a few advantages, a power like this did come with... a cost.
Emotions represented the very core of one’s being, erasing them, even momentarily, was... altering one’s own being.
It was like... erasing a part of oneself.
Sure, something like that wouldn’t affect Nux, his mind was... too powerful at this point to be affected by little tricks like this—
But he didn’t have the time to explain it all to Allura, not to mention, what the women were saying was correct.
This was an emotional moment, and he needed to be here, emotionally. For his wives, for his child... and for himself.
So...
"Are you sure...?"
Nux glanced at Shadow and asked.
"Who do you think I am?"
Shadow grinned, she even opened her palm and placed it right in front of Nux’s eyes.
"See? No trembling."
She spoke with a superior grin, Nux looked at her with a deadpan look on his face, but then he shook his head and asked seriously—
"Are you absolutely sure? Space is a complicated energy—"
"Oh come on!"
Shadow waved her hand.
"Anything you can do, in here, I can do as well."
She spoke as she patted her non-existent biceps. Nux and the rest of the women looked at Shadow with suspicion, but deep down they knew it as well.
Shadow was capable, more than what she portrayed. She had control over all twelve primordial energies in the Universe and through all these years, she had learned to use them with great accuracy.
There were quite a few beings with power over space in Nux’s Universe, beings he could easily turn into puppets and have them do their bidding but—

None of them had stronger control than Shadow, that was how good she was. After all, space was a complicated power to acquire, and Shadow, on the other hand, had the Law of Absolute Space under her command.
"Let me do it."
So Shadow nodded confidently, then she glanced at Allura, as if she was asking for permission, Allura nodded, Shadow nodded back. Nux didn’t move, he continued to kneel beside Allura, waiting.
Shadow then stepped forward and after looking at Allura one last time, she activated the space energy around him.
The space energy then enveloped around Allura, Nux tightened his hold on Allura’s hand as he saw it all happen.
A strange pressure formed in the room, it was as if everything inside was holding its breath to watch it happen.
The space energy now converged around Allura’s stomach, as if it was picking something from inside.
And that was when both Nux and Shadow began to notice the change in the very Universe.
This was the first time natural birth was being given to a full entity inside Nux’s Universe, so the Universe itself didn’t know the ’rules’ at play here.
It was... writing everything as it went.
Nux and Shadow exchanged a look, Nux’s hands trembled even more strongly and the moment Allura sensed it, she tightened her grip on his hand, making him turn to her again.
And that was when it happened—
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE

Nux’s Universe trembled, Nux felt a stinging headache, enough to make even him, a being who had swung his sword with a big grin on his face even when his limbs were cut off, react, and that surprised him.
Of course, his expression quickly returned to normal, making sure Allura didn’t see it. His mind, however, had already started thinking about what was happening.

Shadow sensed it all as well, she could sense that a new connection was being formed but because this time it wasn’t Nux devouring something from the main Universe, but something that came from within, the Universe was reacting differently, it was... adjusting.
And this adjustment—
It was all happening with Allura.
A soft crimson glow spread across Allura’s skin and... strange symbols, symbols that Nux instantly recognized as ancient Succubus symbols, formed on her collarbone all the way down to her stomach.
"Hnngg!!"
Allura gasped and arched slightly.
"Are you alright!?"
Nux questioned in panic, holding her even tighter.
"It... stings a little.
But not much."
Allura shook her head and smiled lightly, Nux felt his heart shudder when he saw that expression, but Vyriana placed her hand on his shoulder and—

"Don’t treat her like a child. There was a time she trained with me, if she says it just stings, then it just stings, don’t think too deeply about this. She is far stronger than whatever you are treating her like."
The Dragon spoke with a strict look on her face and Nux...
He lowered his head and nodded.
He then turned towards Allura and smiled again. Shadow continued as well, the Universe calmed down as well and with that—
The crimson glow on Allura’s body turned into seductive purple, signifying Allura’s blood, which was then mixed with... Nux’s gold-black, symbolizing his... impossible existence.
The two glows continued to mix with each other, the symbols on Allura’s body began to change as well, transforming into something even... Nux did not understand.
A strange occurrence.
How could a Universe itself not know what the Universe was doing?
It was because this was something new.
Something that... did not exist before this.
Nux’s child.
It carried a blood different from any existing race in Nux’s Universe and in the main Universe.
That was when Shadow waved her hand, the space energy moved again and suddenly something appeared above Allura’s belly.
A core.
A gold-purple-black core.
No...
It wasn’t just a simple core.
The instant the women sensed the Universe forming a connection with this ’core’, they realized what it was.
It was Nux and Allura’s baby.
Allura saw it as well, and the moment she did, a beautiful smile of relief appeared on her face as her skin began to return to normal.
The strain that was making her feel this heavy was finally lifted and she—
She could now finally lay her head down on the pillow in relief.
As for the core that was now hovering in the air—
It pulsed.

The entire room pulsed with it and every woman in the room felt it. Aeliana’s hand moved to her stomach. Evane inhaled sharply. Even Amaya went still, there was a complex emotion in her eyes as she saw the ’child.’
And finally—
Crack
The core cracked, like an egg opening from the inside, soft, warm and strangely calm light spilled out in the room and in that light—
A small figure finally took shape.
A baby boy.
The boy didn’t scream, neither did he cry, he just... slowly opened his eyes, and those eyes with that distinct shade of purple scanned the room before they rested on his father.
Nux.
And when Nux looked back at his child, he froze.
It was like the entire Universe had isolated him and he couldn’t sense anything around him, his mind had... completely collapsed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2300: A Primordial Incubus.
paragraphs: A soft, warm, and oddly calming light spread in the room and a small figure took shape.
A baby boy.

Nux looked at him, he looked at the little thing in front of him, the thing that, instead of crying like children do, was looking around the room, scanning everything, every person around him, before his big eyes finally rested on him.
And the moment their eyes met—
Time around him came to a complete halt.

To the women, Nux seemed frozen. Like one of the Infinities fighting could die right now and the other could be in a near-death state, giving Nux the full chance to get rid of two enemies at the same time, and he still wouldn’t move.
It was as if he had... completely lost all his senses.
And how could he not?
The women were the same too, although they weren’t as overwhelmed as Nux was, but no matter what they said or did, the little thing floating in the air in front of them was their child too.
They felt this strong urge to extend their hands and pull him into their embrace but—
They did not.

This was all new for them, a magical moment like this. They didn’t wish to ruin it by doing something forcefully, they would let the child do what he wants and, at the same time, enjoy Nux’s reaction.
"The Universe’s enemy, they say~"
Aisha couldn’t help but crack a joke, staring at Nux, looking at his child with this... foolish look on his face.
The rest of the women smiled, even Amaya was no different.
"I wonder how the people of the Universe would react if they saw him like this."
Felberta questioned with a playful smirk and just then—
"We will know soon enough."
They heard these amused, scheming words and in an instant—
The women turned to a particular direction and saw... Edda.
The woman grinned and winked at the women and that reaction alone made the rest of the women wary.
Vyriana called out, narrowing her eyes suspiciously.
"Are you recording?"
She questioned directly and the moment Edda’s grin widened even further, the women got the answer.
"Since when?"
Astaria asked and Edda just shrugged—
"Since we came here."
Then Edda’s grin became even more mischievous as she stared at all the women around him and—
"Don’t worry, I captured your reactions too.
It will be fun~"
Ember clenched her fists, trying to hold back.
Vyriana however didn’t even try, she rushed towards Edda, prepared to make her delete the recording, at least hers, even if it meant she needed to use force but...
The moment Vyriana was about to grab her,
"Hehek~"
A cute, unbearably adorable laugh echoed through the room, the women all turned around and saw the child extending his little arms towards his father.

And the moment that happened, Nux, who was lost in his own world, not moving even when the women joked around him, suddenly came out of his reverie and rushed towards his child as if, if he lost this moment, he would lose everything.
The next instant, the baby was already in his embrace and Nux—
He held him so delicately, as if he was the most precious thing in the world.
In response, the baby too held Nux’s finger with his small hand, a grip so small, yet so... strong that Nux...
He felt overwhelmed, this time even more strongly. He couldn’t move his eyes away from the child’s little hand that was holding his finger.
The sight was so... precious that he burned it into his memory, as strongly as he could.
The baby too—
"H-He’s here."
Finally, Nux spoke, his voice cracking. He could feel a lump forming inside his throat. The child in his arms made him feel emotions he had never felt before.
Love, care, responsibility, of course, these were all the emotions he felt for his wives too, but now—
It felt different.
Now it felt... even stronger.

Without thinking, Nux slowly kissed the child’s forehead, then he slowly looked at Allura, who was smiling at him in her exhausted state. Honestly, she could have Shadow or Nux help her recover her fatigue, but she wanted this moment to be as natural as possible.
She wanted to hold her baby in her tired arms, then stick him close to her tired body.
And that was exactly what she did, the moment Nux came to her, she slowly took the baby and placed him on her breasts.
"Hehek~"
The baby laughed again.
Just like his father, he could sense his mother too and the moment he was in his mother’s embrace, the safest place for the child to be—
He yawned and...
And then he rested his big head on Allura’s breasts and closed his eyes.
Yes, he started sleeping.
"He’s tired already?"
Thyra raised her eyebrow.
"It wasn’t just Allura who was under the strain, he was as well."
Shadow answered. The women looked at her and the Universe’s Goddess explained—

"This is the first time it has happened, the Universe doesn’t know how to make it ’comfortable’, so while Nux’s subconscious is strong enough to ensure the child’s safety, it still cannot make the entire process flow with ease, at least not on the first attempt. After all, there was nothing much to ’experiment’ on."
The women nodded at those words.

They watched the baby sleeping in Allura’s arms with gentle smiles on their faces, then they looked at Allura who had a ridiculously beautiful smile on her face, so gentle and fresh that even when she wasn’t trying to charm anyone, her charm still oozed out.
"He’s beautiful."
Skyla commented, looking at the baby from close with a tilted head.
"Congratulations."

Felberta looked at Allura and smiled gently, Allura nodded back. The rest of the women walked closer as well, none of them touched the baby, he was exhausted, so it was better for him to sleep and none of them wished to disturb him.
Yes, like Nux, they too were being extra delicate with him.
"Thank you."
Allura nodded with a weak smile.
"He really is beautiful, huh~"
Aisha commented as well, staring at the baby.
She had already seen his eyes, they were... captivating.

His ears were slightly pointed, not fully human. Tiny, delicate horns, that were only small bumps for now, were resting above his head. Behind him was a small tail that seemed like it still hadn’t formed properly yet.
*Picture*
"Indeed."
Eisheth nodded as well.

Like his mother, the baby too had a strong air of charm around him, it was different from the usual Incubus charm, but at the same time it was quite similar as well. Eisheth couldn’t quite put her finger on it.
So in her confusion, she turned towards Nux and—
"So... what is he?"
She questioned directly. The rest of the women wanted to know as well.
They had asked this before, Nux avoided that question the last time, but now the women won’t allow it. Nux too wasn’t in his right mind to play such games.
His eyes were still on his sleeping child, so without even looking at Eisheth, he answered her question.
"He is an Incubus.
A Primordial Incubus."
"A... Primordial Incubus?"
Eisheth frowned in confusion.
It wasn’t just her, the rest of the women were the same. If it was a few centuries ago, they would have been surprised, they would have considered it strong.
A Primordial-level bloodline, back when they were in Yrniel, that indeed had a good ring to it. It felt... powerful.
But now...
A Primordial-level bloodline felt weak, especially when every single one of them had a Progenitor-level bloodline.
The women couldn’t understand how a child with a Succubus Progenitor as his mother and a... literal Universe as a father could be a mere... Primordial Incubus.
But the women didn’t say it out loud.
This was a happy moment, they did not wish to ruin it.
So Eisheth just nodded and asked a simple question—
"So how strong is his Primordial blood? A High-Level World, I expect?"
If he was a Primordial-level being, at the very least, he should be as strong as a Primordial being from a High-Level World, no?
At that question, however, Nux turned towards Eisheth with a frown.
"A High-Level World?"
He tilted his head, confused. Soon however, he realized what he had just said and quickly shook his head.
"No, no, of course not!
He doesn’t have a Primordial-level bloodline.
Heisa Primordial Incubus."
He clarified, at least from his perspective, but the women only stared at him with foolish gazes. They had absolutely no clue what he was talking about.
Nux noticed that look on their faces, then he took a slight pause and—
"You remember the twelve Primordial Energies, the... parents of all the existing energies?"
The women nodded.
The existence of the Universe depended on these twelve energies, they understood tha—
"Wait..."
Suddenly, Eisheth’s expression changed.
And Nux nodded.
"Yes, a Primordial Incubus."
He smiled at his child.
"Our Universe’s first Incubus, he isn’t just a Progenitor of a single World, he is the Progenitor of ALL the Incubi that will ever exist in our Universe.
Don’t compare his bloodline to the normal power scale you know.
He is beyond that scale."
Nux’s smile then turned even more loving and—
"After all, he is the Universe’s Child."

sentences.text: A soft, warm, and oddly calming light spread in the room and a small figure took shape.
A baby boy.

Nux looked at him, he looked at the little thing in front of him, the thing that, instead of crying like children do, was looking around the room, scanning everything, every person around him, before his big eyes finally rested on him.
And the moment their eyes met—
Time around him came to a complete halt.
To the women, Nux seemed frozen.

Like one of the Infinities fighting could die right now and the other could be in a near-death state, giving Nux the full chance to get rid of two enemies at the same time, and he still wouldn’t move.
It was as if he had... completely lost all his senses.
And how could he not?
The women were the same too, although they weren’t as overwhelmed as Nux was, but no matter what they said or did, the little thing floating in the air in front of them was their child too.
They felt this strong urge to extend their hands and pull him into their embrace but—
They did not.
This was all new for them, a magical moment like this.
They didn’t wish to ruin it by doing something forcefully, they would let the child do what he wants and, at the same time, enjoy Nux’s reaction.
"The Universe’s enemy, they say~"
Aisha couldn’t help but crack a joke, staring at Nux, looking at his child with this... foolish look on his face.
The rest of the women smiled, even Amaya was no different.
"I wonder how the people of the Universe would react if they saw him like this."
Felberta questioned with a playful smirk and just then—
"We will know soon enough."
They heard these amused, scheming words and in an instant—
The women turned to a particular direction and saw...
Edda.
The woman grinned and winked at the women and that reaction alone made the rest of the women wary.
Vyriana called out, narrowing her eyes suspiciously.
"Are you recording?"
She questioned directly and the moment Edda’s grin widened even further, the women got the answer.
"Since when?"
Astaria asked and Edda just shrugged—
"Since we came here."
Then Edda’s grin became even more mischievous as she stared at all the women around him and—
"Don’t worry, I captured your reactions too.
It will be fun~"
Ember clenched her fists, trying to hold back.
Vyriana however didn’t even try, she rushed towards Edda, prepared to make her delete the recording, at least hers, even if it meant she needed to use force but...
The moment Vyriana was about to grab her,
"Hehek~"
A cute, unbearably adorable laugh echoed through the room, the women all turned around and saw the child extending his little arms towards his father.

And the moment that happened, Nux, who was lost in his own world, not moving even when the women joked around him, suddenly came out of his reverie and rushed towards his child as if, if he lost this moment, he would lose everything.
The next instant, the baby was already in his embrace and Nux—
He held him so delicately, as if he was the most precious thing in the world.
In response, the baby too held Nux’s finger with his small hand, a grip so small, yet so... strong that Nux...
He felt overwhelmed, this time even more strongly.
He couldn’t move his eyes away from the child’s little hand that was holding his finger.
The sight was so... precious that he burned it into his memory, as strongly as he could.
The baby too—
"H-He’s here."
Finally, Nux spoke, his voice cracking.
He could feel a lump forming inside his throat.
The child in his arms made him feel emotions he had never felt before.
Love, care, responsibility, of course, these were all the emotions he felt for his wives too, but now—
It felt different.
Now it felt... even stronger.
Without thinking, Nux slowly kissed the child’s forehead, then he slowly looked at Allura, who was smiling at him in her exhausted state.
Honestly, she could have Shadow or Nux help her recover her fatigue, but she wanted this moment to be as natural as possible.
She wanted to hold her baby in her tired arms, then stick him close to her tired body.
And that was exactly what she did, the moment Nux came to her, she slowly took the baby and placed him on her breasts.
"Hehek~"
The baby laughed again.
Just like his father, he could sense his mother too and the moment he was in his mother’s embrace, the safest place for the child to be—
He yawned and...
And then he rested his big head on Allura’s breasts and closed his eyes.
Yes, he started sleeping.
"He’s tired already?"
Thyra raised her eyebrow.
"It wasn’t just Allura who was under the strain, he was as well."
Shadow answered.
The women looked at her and the Universe’s Goddess explained—

"This is the first time it has happened, the Universe doesn’t know how to make it ’comfortable’, so while Nux’s subconscious is strong enough to ensure the child’s safety, it still cannot make the entire process flow with ease, at least not on the first attempt.
After all, there was nothing much to ’experiment’ on."
